name: Wes Moore
subject: Keeping the faith
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1518%2E1086043%2EU3VLC7)
Keeping the faith is harder than ever. **_We must do it anyway._**
I want to share something personal, Peter.
When I was three years old, I watched my father die from a rare but treatable illness. He didn't get the health care he needed. My mother had to raise three children on her own.
_But she kept the faith._ And the congregation at Takoma Park Seventh-day Adventist Church surrounded her with love and care. It got us through one of the darkest chapters of our lives.
My great-grandfather Josiah fled the Ku Klux Klan in the middle of the night. My grandfather James returned to America alone with his thick Jamaican accent and led a predominantly white church. _Through it all, they kept the faith._
"Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." — Hebrews 11:1
These days, it's easy to succumb to the darkness. But that's exactly what those who seek to divide us want. We must not give it to them.
**[We're past the midpoint of June, and we need this team to show up before the month ends. Can you chip in $5 to help us keep the faith and keep doing this work together?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260618-1.UngUG6&refcode=em-20260618&t=2&akid=1518%2E1086043%2EU3VLC7)**

Thank you, Peter.
– Wes Moore

# [Shocking poll shows most Americans support trillionaires like Musk](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A new survey finds 57% of Americans accept individuals amassing trillion-dollar fortunes like Elon Musk's, **[but only if the riches come without exploiting other](https://substack.com/redirect/b404d4d6-763d-422f-9a2e-3d41ce674248?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** s or harming fellow participants in the upside.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Survey majority accepts:** 57% deem single-person trillionaire status fine provided no exploitation occurs and others gain opportunity to share prosperity.
* **Capitalism alignment noted:** Respondents believe in the system yet demand it deliver broader wealth creation beyond just top executives or firms.
* **Musk milestone highlighted:** SpaceX debut pushed his stake-driven net worth past $1.1 trillion, exceeding combined fortunes of Bezos, Gates, Zuckerberg and Buffett.
* **Political pushback cited:** Senators Warren and Sanders condemned the valuation, citing typical household would need millions of years of work to match.

# [Musk's SpaceX has 38 % shot at becoming worlds top company](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Freshly public at $2.6 trillion and fifth-largest company, SpaceX faces long odds in options markets to overtake Nvidia for the top spot, **[with traders giving roughly 38% chance by June 2028.](https://substack.com/redirect/c8a55d8d-a675-4028-b898-105434be7003?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Current valuation race:** Company sits neck-and-neck with Amazon for fifth place, over $1 trillion ahead of Tesla but needs 70% rally to pass Apple and Alphabet.
* **Option strike analysis:** June 2028 calls imply 46% probability of reaching $340 share price needed for second place.
* **Longer term outlook:** December 2028 extends odds of toppling Nvidia to 41% as market bets on sustained growth.
* **Index fast track:** Debut perks include quick derivatives trading and benchmark inclusion yet path to first remains years away per crowd pricing.

* * *
* * *
# [Your 401k is already betting big on Elon Musk's rocket](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With SpaceX up more than 30% since its IPO, millions of **[401(k) holders may hold the stock indirectly through active mutual funds](https://substack.com/redirect/45ce446a-0be9-4d3e-9f90-cfeea3e1d6c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** or soon via Russell 1000 and Nasdaq-100 indexes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Active fund exposure:** Fidelity parent FMR owns nearly 1% across 46 funds while Baron funds allocate over 20% of assets to the aerospace giant.
* **Index inclusion timeline:** Russell will add, after five trading days, on Thursday, while Nasdaq-100 entry lands July 6, flowing into passive ETFs.
* **Modest initial weight:** Low public float keeps influence small yet strong performance still benefits holders without direct purchase.
* **Awareness advised:** Investors urged to check portfolio holdings for concentration risk aligned to long-term goals.

* * *
* * *
# [SpaceX IPO tax windfall shrinks fast as California workers get clever](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Blockbuster debuts of SpaceX, OpenAI and Anthropic **[promise revenue for California](https://substack.com/redirect/20cc330e-55e4-4660-a8c4-4a191ecc966a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/20cc330e-55e4-4660-a8c4-4a191ecc966a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)yet dual-trigger RSUs, (restricted stock, units) donor funds and pre-IPO sales may blunt and delay the expected billions compared to past Facebook-level hauls.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Unique vesting structure:** SpaceX taxed employee RSUs on employment alone, pulling revenue forward and making IPO-day boom less dramatic.
* **Mitigation tools widespread:** Employees now donate pre-IPO shares to donor-advised funds and use loans against equity to defer capital gains.
* **Tender offer impact:** OpenAI's $6.6 billion secondary sale already taxed gains early, spreading revenue unpredictably for state forecasters.
* **Historical benchmark:** Facebook generated $1.3 billion at $104 billion valuation but current maneuvers likely trim immediate upside.

# [Intel explodes 7% after Trump lands Apple U.S. manufacturing win](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/89214adb-e12a-438c-ac16-02ebd59cc8b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[announced Apple will design and build chips with Intel in America,](https://substack.com/redirect/89214adb-e12a-438c-ac16-02ebd59cc8b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/89214adb-e12a-438c-ac16-02ebd59cc8b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)sending shares up sharply as the foundry business gains major customers amid AI and supply chain shifts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Stock performance boost:** Intel climbed 7% Thursday and 464% over past year to $608 billion market cap after years of struggle.
* **Broader commitments noted:** Nvidia agreed first-level chips with Intel while Elon's TerraFab project uses company technology for world's largest factory.
* **Manufacturing revival:** CEO Lip-Bu Tan drew Trump administration investment helping counter Taiwan dominance and Middle East disruptions.
* **Semiconductor index rise:** Sector benchmark up 90% this year as AI insulates from oil price volatility.

# [Gas prices crash below $4 after Iran breakthrough opens Hormuz route](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Average gasoline fell to $3.99 Thursday, **[extending 28 straight days of declines,](https://substack.com/redirect/0e1ecb8d-0e30-4b1a-ab41-8da8189dd993?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Trump's Iran agreement eases fears of prolonged Strait of Hormuz closure that once disrupted 20 percent of global oil.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Historical comparison:** Prices remain 30% above pre-war levels from February 28 attack and retaliation that halted tanker traffic.
* **Navy assistance role:** U.S. forces escorted tankers through the Strait since May while deal signals gradual export recovery.
* **Longest decline streak:** Drop from May 21 peak of $4.56 matches longest run since November 2023.
* **Supply impact scale:** Hormuz previously carried one-fifth world oil before Tehran's commercial ship attacks triggered largest disruption ever.

* * *
* * *
# [Hollister and Target team up to grab huge $89 billion college cash wave](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Abercrombie's youth brand **[launches 60-item dorm and apparel collection at Target](https://substack.com/redirect/316c7f63-e7d0-4601-b39d-18c1e9994007?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/316c7f63-e7d0-4601-b39d-18c1e9994007?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)stores and online June 28, expanding beyond clothing into home goods to tap $12.8 billion furnishings slice of college shopping.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Collaboration details:** Joint designs cover men's and women's apparel plus bedding with Target handling manufacturing through 2027 seasons.
* **Growth strategy shift:** Hollister seeks lifestyle status and new customers via Target's footprint amid discretionary spending slowdown.
* **Market size context:** Last year's back-to-college total hit $88.8 billion with furnishings second only to electronics.
* **Future evolution:** Plans include blankets, plush and seasonal dorm refreshes for 13-to-22 demographic.

* * *
* * *
# [Porsche just turned Toy Story's Woody Buzz and Jessie into real 911s](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At the Los Angeles premiere, **[Porsche unveiled three custom 911 models inspired by iconic characters,](https://substack.com/redirect/b7d685a0-a87f-4eb0-a913-5ea6436e82fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** created by its Sonderwunsch team and auctioned to benefit children's charities including Big Brothers Big Sisters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e21cb9f9-2709-4104-a33c-931835e26025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Specific model features:** Buzz GT3 RS gets space-ranger colors and "To Infinity and Beyond" sills while Jessie Targa features new white metallic paint and "YEE HAW!" accents.
* **Woody design touches:** Carrera T mimics denim jeans texture with vintage leather and "Ride Like the Wind!" sill guards.
* **Charity focus:** Proceeds support American Red Cross, Starlight Children's Foundation alongside collaboration with Pixar's original Buzz designer.
* **CEO excitement shared:** Timo Resch highlighted childhood nostalgia and joy for families in need through the milestone film tie-in.

Peter,

ICE and CBP agents are detaining American citizens with no charges filed and no immigration violations found. This is not immigration enforcement. This is unlawful detention of people who have every right to be here.

Recently, I wrote to ICE Acting Director Lyons demanding that it stop immediately. **[Will you sign my petition and stand with me?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133582721/628364950/923944034?source=EM_NBI_SM_20260618_PT_ICE_0_3MO_SethMagaziner_NA_NA_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MmUzNWQ4NS0zZDZiLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=izk1BegyW-knzEAnG1_FpKiLwHfM-re6clIaN2Jyq-k=&emci=e6c4667f-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=52e35d85-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=15384964)**
| | **[SIGN THE PETITION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133582722/628364981/923944034?source=EM_NBI_SM_20260618_PT_ICE_0_3MO_SethMagaziner_NA_NA_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MmUzNWQ4NS0zZDZiLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=izk1BegyW-knzEAnG1_FpKiLwHfM-re6clIaN2Jyq-k=&emci=e6c4667f-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=52e35d85-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=15384964)**

No one should be detained by their own government without cause. No charges. No violations. Just American citizens being held because agents decided to hold them.

I will not stay quiet while this administration treats the rights of American citizens as optional, and I want to know you will not either.

**[Add your name and stand with me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133582724/628364982/923944034?source=EM_NBI_SM_20260618_PT_ICE_0_3MO_SethMagaziner_NA_NA_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MmUzNWQ4NS0zZDZiLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=izk1BegyW-knzEAnG1_FpKiLwHfM-re6clIaN2Jyq-k=&emci=e6c4667f-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=52e35d85-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=15384964)**

Faith, truth, and the next generation| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). subject: FIVE DAYS AFTER ETHICS LAW PASSES, FLEMING STILL WON'T SAY IF HE'S QUITTING DC LOBBYING FIRM
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
Letlow continues call for Fleming to resign from McKeon D.C. Lobbying Group or resign from office

| | |

| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/DCtLPpNtxwg?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a)
| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEJune 18. 2026katherine@julialetlow.com
**FIVE DAYS AFTER ETHICS LAW PASSES, FLEMING STILL WON'T SAY IF HE'S QUITTING DC LOBBYING FIRM** _Letlow continues call for Fleming to resign from McKeon D.C. Lobbying Group or resign from office_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Five days after Governor Jeff Landry signed House Bill 210 into law prohibiting statewide elected officials from being paid to lobby, advise, or consult while serving in office, State Treasurer John Fleming has yet to say whether he has resigned from the Washington lobbying firm that pays him or whether he intends to step down from office.
Fleming joined The McKeon Group, a Washington lobbying and consulting firm, as a registered lobbyist in 2021 and transitioned to an “advisor” after being elected State Treasurer. During the Louisiana U.S. Senate debate, Fleming acknowledged that he receives monthly payments from the firm while simultaneously serving as Louisiana State Treasurer. According to Fleming's financial disclosure forms, he was paid more than $40,000 by the firm in 2024.
Despite the law taking effect five days ago, Fleming has not publicly stated whether he has resigned from the McKeon Group, nor has he announced plans to step down as State Treasurer.
_"Five days have passed since Governor Landry signed this legislation, and John Fleming still hasn't told the people of Louisiana whether he intends to comply with the law,"_ **said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.** _"This should not be complicated. If John Fleming wants to remain State Treasurer, he should resign from the Washington lobbying firm that pays him. If he wants to stay on the payroll of a Washington lobbying firm, he should resign as State Treasurer. Louisiana taxpayers deserve a clear answer."_
House Bill 210 leaves Fleming with a straightforward choice: end his relationship with the Washington lobbying firm or step down from statewide office. To date, he has done neither.

body:
Trump wants to deploy the National Guard at polling sites
#
Peter —
The Military is trained not to follow illegal orders. We know this very well.
But for the grunts on the ground, it’s often not clear what an illegal order is. That puts them between choosing their oath to the Constitution and the chain of command.
Here’s an example: There are federal and state laws banning American Troops at polling sites. Those laws thread under the same legal framework as the Posse Comitatus Act, and the principle that Military power must be separate from civilian law enforcement. It must not impede upon democratic processes. It exists to defend Americans, not to intimidate or police them.

Democracy Docket: With New Order, Trump Tries to Kill Off Vote By Mail [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=061826_2&amount=25]
We're going to keep hammering this home, Team, because the mainstream media continues to ignore this executive order and how it will change our elections forever.
President Donald Trump's massive anti-voting executive order has sent lawmakers, election officials, and voting rights advocates into a frenzy. One provision focuses on a goal that for years has been a borderline obsession for MAGA: Cracking down on voting by mail .
For background: After every election in which he's been a candidate or in power, Trump has raged over the use of mail-in ballots in general and ballot deadlines in particular . He's tried to claim fraud for every single ballot counted after Election Day.
So of course, this order directs the Attorney General to “ take all necessary action ” against any states that count absentee or mail-in ballots received after Election Day.
This order makes it clear that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
We can win and protect our elections and our fundamental right to vote. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend vote by mail across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=061826_2&amount=35]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure , mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”

During World War II, President Franklin Roosevelt called the United States the "Arsenal of Democracy." He wasn't reaching for poetry. He was describing the industrial capacity that made Allied victory possible. Today that lesson is overdue for a revival. As the United States confronts renewed geopolitical competition and growing economic uncertainty, national security begins with industrial strength. A nation cannot build ships and tanks without the capacity to make steel. That is why this week marks an important milestone: one year since Nippon Steel's investment in U.S. Steel brought allied capital, American workers, and industrial modernization together in support of a stronger domestic steel industry.
China now produces [60%](https://substack.com/redirect/84a474d0-f648-46f9-9074-855e3efee12a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the world's steel. If you're not alarmed by that number, consider what steel actually builds: aircraft carriers, armored vehicles, energy pipelines, and the physical infrastructure of a functioning military. China's dominance in steel production didn't happen through innovation. It happened through sustained state subsidies that flooded global markets, suppressed prices, and left American producers in a structurally weakened position.
That is why the[ $14.9 billion acquisition of U.S. Steel by Japan's Nippon Steel](https://substack.com/redirect/c6ba9058-ed3d-4a6c-b235-ff6ce7cac8de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) commanded national attention when it was announced in December 2023 and was approved by President Trump in 2025.
You can read my full piece in _[RealClearPennsylvania](https://substack.com/redirect/96821d1b-c67e-49c5-8c3b-b42ef345eadc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _

Annual paid subscribers will receive a digital copy of my 2008 memoir, . * | | | Jun 18 | | | | | | | | | | | | During World War II, President Franklin Roosevelt called the United States the "Arsenal of Democracy." He wasn't reaching for poetry. He was describing the industrial capacity that made Allied victory possible. Today that lesson is overdue for a revival. As the United States confronts renewed geopolitical competition and growing economic uncertainty, national security begins with industrial strength. A nation cannot build ships and tanks without the capacity to make steel. That is why this week marks an important milestone: one year since Nippon Steel's investment in U.S. Steel brought allied capital, American workers, and industrial modernization together in support of a stronger domestic steel industry. China now produces of the world's steel. If you're not alarmed by that number, consider what steel actually builds: aircraft carriers, armored vehicles, energy pipelines, and the physical infrastructure of a functioning military. China's dominance in steel production didn't happen through innovation. It happened through sustained state subsidies that flooded global markets, suppressed prices, and left American producers in a structurally weakened position. That is why the commanded national attention when it was announced in December 2023 and was approved by President Trump in 2025. Dear Peter, Five people did real harm. **All five walked free — thanks to Donald Trump.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133586791/628376289/-383741655?refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260618_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTllM2I4MC00NTZiLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4oMmU4T8GWA0WQhwMH_5VAc1R0U5GsAf67l39mwBds4=)
_Source: Daniel Torok_ The rioter convicted of assaulting a Capitol Police Officer so badly it ended his 17-year career — sentenced to seven years, **pardoned.** The Virginia sheriff convicted of selling badges for $75,000 in bribes — 10 years, **pardoned hours before he was due to report to prison.** Even Virginia's Republican attorney general objected to that one. The truck-company founder who towed a non-working truck to the top of a hill, filmed it rolling down, and sold investors their savings on the lie that it ran — **pardoned before he paid back a cent of the $660 million he owed them.** The nursing home boss convicted of raiding more than $7 million from his own employees' paychecks to buy a yacht — **pardoned weeks after his mother attended a $1-million-a-head dinner at Mar-a-Lago.** The congressman convicted of defrauding his own donors and stealing identities to do it — **sentence cut short, the $374,000 George Santos owed his victims erased.** Notice who's missing from every story? The victims. Nobody made them whole. One congressional analysis estimated that Trump's pardons and commutations have let recipients skip more than **_$1.3 billion_** in restitution and fines owed to victims and taxpayers — money those victims will never see. But here's what they don't want you thinking about: a presidential pardon only covers federal crimes. _Donald Trump can't pardon state crimes._ This week in the New York Times, law professor Tim Wu made the point plainly: states are their own sovereigns, and a federal pardon can't stop them from enforcing their own laws. He pointed to a nursing home fraudster Trump pardoned federally — whom Arkansas's Republican attorney general then made serve state time and pay restitution on a separate state case anyway. Where Washington walks away, states can still hold the line. That's why state courts matter so much right now. The rule of law doesn't live in a building in Washington — it lives in every county courthouse, in every prosecutor who treats people equally, with no exceptions for the powerful and no special deals for the connected. That's what this campaign is all about. **[So here's what we're asking. If you believe the law should mean the same thing for everybody — the police officer, the worker, the small investor, and yes, the powerful and the well-connected too — then stand with us today. Chip in $25 and help us take this fight to every doorstep in Wake County.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133586792/628376290/-383741655?amount=25&refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260618_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTllM2I4MC00NTZiLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4oMmU4T8GWA0WQhwMH_5VAc1R0U5GsAf67l39mwBds4=)** | [CHIP IN $25](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133586793/628376291/-383741655?amount=25&refcode=AU_GWN_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260618_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOTllM2I4MC00NTZiLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4oMmU4T8GWA0WQhwMH_5VAc1R0U5GsAf67l39mwBds4=)

clean_body: | Dear Peter, Five people did real harm. All five walked free — thanks to Donald Trump. = Source: Daniel Torok The rioter convicted of assaulting a Capitol Police Officer so badly it ended his 17-year career — sentenced to seven years, pardoned. The Virginia sheriff convicted of selling badges for $75,000 in bribes — 10 years, pardoned hours before he was due to report to prison. Even Virginia's Republican attorney general objected to that one. The truck-company founder who towed a non-working truck to the top of a hill, filmed it rolling down, and sold investors their savings on the lie that it ran — pardoned before he paid back a cent of the $660 million he owed them. The nursing home boss convicted of raiding more than $7 million from his own employees' paychecks to buy a yacht — pardoned weeks after his mother attended a $1-million-a-head dinner at Mar-a-Lago. The congressman convicted of defrauding his own donors and stealing identities to do it — sentence cut short, the $374,000 George Santos owed his victims erased. Notice who's missing from every story? The victims. Nobody made them whole. One congressional analysis estimated that Trump's pardons and commutations have let recipients skip more than $1.3 billion in restitution and fines owed to victims and taxpayers — money those victims will never see. But here's what they don't want you thinking about: a presidential pardon only covers federal crimes. Donald Trump can't pardon state crimes. This week in the New York Times, law professor Tim Wu made the point plainly: states are their own sovereigns, and a federal pardon can't stop them from enforcing their own laws. He pointed to a nursing home fraudster Trump pardoned federally — whom Arkansas's Republican attorney general then made serve state time and pay restitution on a separate state case anyway. Where Washington walks away, states can still hold the line. That's why state courts matter so much right now. The rule of law doesn't live in a building in Washington — it lives in every county courthouse, in every prosecutor who treats people equally, with no exceptions for the powerful and no special deals for the connected. That's what this campaign is all about. = | = Thanks so much, Team Wiley — Sources: Capitol officer's attacker ( ; removed by Trump DOJ) · Virginia sheriff ( ; ) · truck-company fraud ( ; ) · nursing home executive ( ; ) · congressman ( ; ) · $1.3 billion figure () · state prosecution argument (). Hi Friend,

I want to share some news that means the world to me.

Earlier this year we secured **$1,039,000** in federal funding to expand Oakland's Ceasefire program – the violence prevention project that's helped bring Oakland's homicide rate to its lowest point in decades.

But before I get into the details of why this funding is essential, I want to tell you a story:

Early in my career, I had to bury one of my young people who had been murdered.

When I went to his mother's house, his blood was still on the stoop.

A coworker and I offered to clean it, and we scrubbed that blood off the concrete so she wouldn't have to walk past it every day.

**That moment made me want to fight for a world where our young people get to grow old.**

I'm telling you this because Ceasefire is one of the _best_ tools we have to make that vision real.

Ceasefire is a data-driven program that puts life coaches on our streets – trusted people who walk alongside those most at risk of violence and offer them something different: a path to safe housing, to a steady job, to a future free of violence.

Thanks to this new funding, Oakland's Department of Violence Prevention will be able to hire an additional five life coaches so the program can reach more people who need it.

**An extra million dollars to Ceasefire means fewer mothers losing children. It means fewer stoops that have to be scrubbed clean. It means more children getting to grow old.**

| Right now, a PAC is spending $400,000 attacking me across Denver.
Their ads are disgusting, offensive, and honestly, they're painful to watch.
They are saying that I, an immigrant, do not belong in Denver and that I don't belong in the United States Congress.
Our family has called the Denver area home for decades. We moved here when I was still an infant, and I grew up watching my parents work multiple jobs, navigate an unfamiliar country, pay the bills, and put my father through pharmacy school. They taught me to honor where we come from and to give back to the community that helped raise us.
We are Ethiopian, and we're Denverites - and no anonymous PAC is going to make us feel like we do not belong in the place we call home.
That is what makes these attacks so cruel.
They are not just lying to voters - they're trying to make a family like mine feel like we should be ashamed of our story.
And because they and my opponent can't argue on actual issues or accomplishments, they are calling me "extreme."
So, let's unpack that.
Is it extreme to ban corporate PAC money from buying influence in our politics? How about believing our tax dollars shouldn't be handed over to Israel to fund a genocide in Gaza - especially while working people here are being consumed by medical debt, and children are going to bed hungry?
Is it extreme to fight for universal childcare so parents can work, kids can thrive, and families can actually breathe?
I don't think any of that is extreme. I think it is common sense.
What's extreme is a political system where anonymous PACs can swoop into Denver at the last minute, spend hundreds of thousands of dollars, hide who is funding them, and flood our city with racist, xenophobic attacks to protect the status quo.
They are lying about who I am, trying to scare voters, and telling people I "don't belong."
But Denver knows better. We ALL belong in this fight because working people deserve someone who will fight like hell for them.
If these PACs are willing to spend $400,000 to stop us, then they know exactly what we know. We can win.

clean_body: | Fellow American, Maine is one of the most critical Senate races in the country right now, and I mean that. If we lose Maine, we will lose the Senate. Right now, Elizabeth Warren, Bernie Sanders, and the rest of the socialists are putting their weight behind Graham Platner — a fake oysterman, silver spoon liberal who has been hiding who he really is from Maine voters for this entire campaign. I served in Iraq and Afghanistan, so I'll say this plainly: I know what character looks like, and I know what the absence of it looks like, too. Platner got caught with a Nazi tattoo and claims he had absolutely no idea it was a Nazi tattoo. What a remarkable coincidence, because this is also a man who openly despises Israel and has made a habit of sitting down with antisemites on their podcasts. A fellow veteran, pointing the finger at the institution — at the men and women who served alongside him — to save himself from the truth regarding his own choices. Susan Collins has spent decades proving she's the real thing. She doesn't manufacture a biography. She doesn't pass the buck. She fights for Maine — and right now she needs your help to fight off the millions Bernie Sanders and the radical Left are pouring into this race. subject: The Results Are In.
body:
The voters of San Mateo County and San Francisco County have spoken.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b6506b7fe311/join-me-rep-diana-degette-for-lunch-in-ca-17665319?e=feea60f246)

[|

| |

### Dear Peter,

The voters of San Mateo County and San Francisco County have spoken - and I’m humbled by their overwhelming support.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/vntRXIQklJM?e=feea60f246&c2id=eff6f64158732e8851993770f57c9616)
| | I am enormously grateful to you and every one of our grass roots supporters who made this primary election victory possible. Every donation, every door knock, every phone call, every endorsement, and every vote mattered. Since day one, you have believed that our community deserves an experienced leader in Congress who listens, shows up, and fights for working families.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/J4YUf5vNTJh?e=feea60f246&c2id=eff6f64158732e8851993770f57c9616)
| | Over the last four years, we have built a progressive vision for CA-15. We have delivered millions of federal dollars for local projects in my district. We have advocated for historic investments to fight climate change. And we have organized fierce opposition to Trump’s reckless authoritarianism.
I am incredibly pleased to advance to the general election. But I will never take any votes for granted. A seat in the United State House of Representatives belongs to the people - not any one member. As such, I will continue to campaign vigorously as we head into November. I hope you’ll join me.
---
| [CLICK HERE TO JOIN ME ](https://us.list-manage.com/2groEejWTiJ?e=feea60f246&c2id=eff6f64158732e8851993770f57c9616)
---
| | As we turn our focus to the general election, we must continue the momentum to ensure Democrats win back the House and stop Donald Trump in his tracks. Our country is facing a defining moment. It’s going to take all of us, working together, to protect our freedoms, strengthen our democratic institutions, and ensure we can rebuild after the current administration’s destruction.If you’re able to contribute - even just a few dollars - it would make a big difference in our ability to keep fighting back. Your continued support will allow us to finish strong in November and bring the blue wave to fruition in California, and across America.
---
| [SUPPORT HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/E7o6gsZQjhq?e=feea60f246&c2id=eff6f64158732e8851993770f57c9616)
---
| | This campaign is about action - not just words. From now until election day, I’ll be working to ensure Democrats continue to send a clear message: We’re rejecting a Republican era marked by broken promises, rising costs, and relentless attacks on health care. I’m so grateful to have you in this fight with us.Let’s get to work.Sincerely,
### Rep. Kevin Mullin
###

### Congressman, CA-15

name: Brandy Byrd
subject: TEAM OPPORTUNITIES
body:
*Greetings Everyone!!!*

We have opportunities for everyone to help us as the "A TEAM" (the A- TEAM
as in the old TV show) working together to turn our Congressional District
Blue!! We want all of Texas to turn Blue but first we must organize and do
the work here in our own backyards. With that being said we have
opportunities for us working together to win this district over.

The dates are June 19th and June 20th for Juneteenth Celebrations.

*June 19, 2026*
*Belton, TX *
Inaugural Juneteenth Celebration at the Harris Center.
Location: Liberty Park
Opportunity - Walk in the 1st ever Juneteenth Celebration in Belton, TX
This is a big one guys. This is something to brag to the family about if
you choose to participate. Please call me at 254.818.5252 if you would like
to participate. We really need you on this one.
Start time - We meet at 0830 to gather then 0900 for the parade lineup.
After the parade every one meets at the Harris Center where the rest of the
festivities take place. As of right now we have 0 people wanting to
participate . We really need people to walk for Justin. 1 or 2 people
cannot do it all.

Killeen, TX
1st of its kind in Killeen, TX the NAACP will be hosting a Jubliee Picnic &
Celebration. You are officially invited to the Picnic!! This will be a fun
one!! This is an indoor/outdoor event. I am hoping next year they will add
fireworks to the celebration. Here there will be events indoors and
outdoors then a reenactment of General Gordan Granger reading General Order
#3. This proclamation declared that all enslaved people in Texas were free
enforcing the Emancipation Proclamation more than two years after it was
initially issued by President Lincoln. This reenactment is with the
historic General Benjamin O. Davis VFW Post 9191. At the VFW 9191 that is
right behind the Douse Center they are having a BBQ.

*Georgetown, TX*
Move the Confederate Monument. Justin will be speaking here at this event.
Time - 3:30-4:30
Location: Georgetown Confederate Monument 710 S. Main St Georgetown, TX
78626
*June 20, 2026*

*Taylor, TX*
Taylor Parade & Brunch Freedom Festival
Now if you pick something this is the one to go to!! In beautiful Taylor,
Texas they are having a Juneteenth Parade. Mrs. Early will be driving and
care and needs Early Team Members to help pass out candy, campaign
literature, and good vibes. In this particular opportunity you will walk in
the parade and pass out goodies. After the parade all will go and have a
seat at the time and eat a completely free brunch at no cost. Better yet,
the cost is the great vibes and good time you will have with your
neighbors. The time to meet and location to meet is still being determined.
This event has 2 maybe 3 people willing to help Mrs. Early in this parade.
We need you as a Team member. This is the only way we can win is as a Team.

*Round Rock, TX*
Juneteenth Celebration
We are sharing a table with Wilco Dems. We are asking people help pair up
with the Wilco Dems and pass out campaign literature and good vibes.The
location is Old Settlers Park at 3300 E. Palm Valley Blvd Round Rock, TX
78665.

*DATA ENTRY - DATA ENTRY - DATA ENTRY - DATA ENTRY- DATA ENTRY - DATA
ENTRY - DATA ENTRY - DATA ENTRY *
*
&*
*Researchers - Researchers - Researchers - Researchers - Researchers -
Researchers - Researchers - Researchers *

Please, Please Please text/call if you truly would like to help and be a
part of the "A TEAM" !!!!

When I first made the call for data entry help I did not realize, I did not
have both parts. I had the spreadsheet, but the source documents that still
needed to be scanned in.....well we have everything now. Due to Juneteenth,
TEAM Early being everywhere at once we will begin data entry on Monday!!!!
Yayyyyy!! The training will last no more than 15 minutes. It is very easy.
I will update it on mobilize. Make sure I have your email address. This is
how you will receive both access to the documents and spreadsheet.

We are looking for anyone that would like to be a field organizer. You need
to be passionate about your community and a Democrat. One of the things we
have to work on as Democrats is organizing. The only way you can learn
organizing is hands on. We are actively looking for several field
organizer. Justin has a lot of ground to cover and one thing is for sure is
we are going to out work our competitor. We are in it to win it. We will
not be outworked. Once we begin working all together we will win!!

My number is 254.818.8252.
Sooner is better than later.

Per usual I want to thank everyone for all that they do and we truly need
you. This is the only way we win is "TOGETHER" You truly can help push
Democracy forward with your time, talents, and money. Campaigns are never a
success on their own. They need "A TEAM" of people ready to help and send
in. This is that moment. We always have work or something that needs to get
done.

I just got promoted to Campaign Manager so we are looking for a Team
Coordinator!! I will begin on Monday. We just got to get through this
weekend. So, if this is you please contact me. It is very people heavy.
Lots of phone calling, asking, and coordinating all over the county.Then
you have to make sure everyone has what they need and are comfortable in
their roles.

L*ast thing....Get Active, Get Involved, because Together We Win!!!!!*

Sincerely,
Ms. Brandy L L. Byrd
Team Coordinator
Justin Early for Congressional District 31

body:
Can I tell you a story, Peter?
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1814%2E124072%2EZ_IzZv)
| | | |
---
Peter,

Lately, I’ve been doing a lot of reflecting on the path that brought me here: leading North Carolina as Governor for eight years, serving as Attorney General and running my first race for the state legislature.
**I’d like to tell you a story about that first campaign.** (If you’re short on time but want to support my current campaign for U.S. Senate, **[you can click here to chip in.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk687&amount=5&t=8&akid=1814%2E124072%2EZ_IzZv)** Thank you!)
Campaigning for the state legislature is a lot different than campaigning for the U.S. Senate – especially back then. I personally knocked on hundreds of doors in our district and spent time doing things like hanging campaign placards.
We printed out two different lists of voters in the district: one with the addresses of our dedicated supporters who wanted yard signs, and one with undecided voters, where we’d send them more information or knock on their door and have a conversation with them.
One night, my dad, eager to help out, grabbed a list, threw a bunch of yard signs in his truck and set off to start putting them in the yards of our supporters.

When he got home, I asked him where he’d been.
**After he told me, I had to break the bad news to him:** I was holding in my hand the list of supporters who wanted yard signs. Turns out, he had the list of undecided voters and mistakenly went and put signs in their yards!
We were both exasperated, so I decided I’d call each of those voters to apologize, tell them exactly happened and let them know we'd be back to pick up the yard sign. I’m glad I did, because most of them thought it was hilarious and told me to leave the sign in the yard – my call had convinced them to vote for me.
**A few weeks later, we won the election – upsetting an incumbent leader in the state legislature. The rest, as they say, is history.**
A lot has changed since my first campaign, but some things haven't: we need to tell the truth and we can’t take a single vote for granted.
Traveling all across the state, getting our message out and meeting with voters directly isn’t cheap. I know we can win this Senate race, but not without grassroots support from folks like you.

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

clean_body: Can I tell you a story, Peter? | | | | | Peter, Lately, I’ve been doing a lot of reflecting on the path that brought me here: leading North Carolina as Governor for eight years, serving as Attorney General and running my first race for the state legislature. I’d like to tell you a story about that first campaign. (If you’re short on time but want to support my current campaign for U.S. Senate, Thank you!) Campaigning for the state legislature is a lot different than campaigning for the U.S. Senate – especially back then. I personally knocked on hundreds of doors in our district and spent time doing things like hanging campaign placards. We printed out two different lists of voters in the district: one with the addresses of our dedicated supporters who wanted yard signs, and one with undecided voters, where we’d send them more information or knock on their door and have a conversation with them. One night, my dad, eager to help out, grabbed a list, threw a bunch of yard signs in his truck and set off to start putting them in the yards of our supporters. When he got home, I asked him where he’d been. After he told me, I had to break the bad news to him: I was holding in my hand the list of supporters who wanted yard signs. Turns out, he had the list of undecided voters and mistakenly went and put signs in their yards! We were both exasperated, so I decided I’d call each of those voters to apologize, tell them exactly happened and let them know we'd be back to pick up the yard sign. I’m glad I did, because most of them thought it was hilarious and told me to leave the sign in the yard – my call had convinced them to vote for me. A few weeks later, we won the election – upsetting an incumbent leader in the state legislature. The rest, as they say, is history. A lot has changed since my first campaign, but some things haven't: we need to tell the truth and we can’t take a single vote for granted. Traveling all across the state, getting our message out and meeting with voters directly isn’t cheap. I know we can win this Senate race, but not without grassroots support from folks like you. subject: This Juneteenth
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Strickland for Washington
body:

| | Tomorrow marks Juneteenth, the day in 1865 when the last enslaved African Americans in Texas finally learned they were free - more than two years after the Emancipation Proclamation was signed into law.

It’s a day to honor Black freedom, Black resilience, and Black excellence. And to recognize that our fight for justice is far from over.

Today, we face an administration working to roll back decades of progress.

Eroding black voting rights and diluting black political power. Slashing programs that expand opportunity. Stripping away public recognition of Black achievement - _even renaming military bases that once honored Black service members and removing Black Historical Figures from National Websites._

body:

---
Friend, this race is heating up, so before I ask you to **_[make an urgent donation toward my goal,](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9511?refcode=jtk904-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10402%2E400544%2EBCuSrS)_** I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for.
I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump.
**I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And _when_ we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. **
**But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first.**
It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. Every dollar we raise right now goes directly into the organizing machinery keeping us in this fight — for justice, for equality, for real change. subject: How JD Vance found his way back to faith
body:
Why JD Vance’s story meant so much to Charlie Kirk| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack.

Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God.

For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed.

Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for.

He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly.

That's why your support matters.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Now's the time to restore faith in God and faith in America before another generation drifts even farther from both. And with you, Charlie's mission will reach further -- and touch more young lives -- than ever before. For Charlie, The Turning Point USA Team - P.S. Fellow Patriot, many young people leave home with a foundation of faith, only to have the culture chip away at it, piece by piece. JD Vance knows what that struggle looks like. So do countless young Americans who Turning Point USA is reaching right now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: A pro-crypto PAC just spent $375,000 to stop us
body:
I don’t have crypto PACs or millions to self-fund. I have you. | | | Hi Friend,

This is urgent.
A pro-crypto super PAC just dropped $375,000 on ads to help Rep. April McClain Delaney in the final week of this primary.
And that’s not happening in a vacuum.
This primary has become a test of whether a congressional seat can be bought.
David Trone has loaned his campaign $25 million. April McClain Delaney has loaned herself more than $10 million. And now, a pro-crypto super PAC is spending $375,000 to prop up Delaney before Election Day.
I’m not a multimillionaire self-funding my campaign. I don’t have crypto PACs rushing in to protect me.

Jamaal Bowman here — former Congressman from New York’s 16th Congressional District.

But they didn’t just come for our seats. They came for our movement. And they thought they won—but we’re just getting started.
At a moment when too many politicians are bending to powerful interests, Cori has never been afraid to tell the truth or fight for everyday people.
And right now, families are struggling to keep up with rising costs. Communities are demanding justice and accountability. And far too many elected officials are more concerned with protecting the status quo than delivering real change.
That's why Cori's voice is so important.
I've seen firsthand how she leads—with courage, conviction, and an unwavering commitment to the people who sent her to Washington. Even when the attacks came. Even when standing up for her values carried a political cost.
Look, these Republican extremist mega-donors are afraid of unbought, unbossed, democratically elected Black candidates like Cori and me. They know that we are champions for racial and economic justice, healthcare for all, reproductive freedom, climate action, and a permanent ceasefire in Gaza—all while rejecting the GOP’s dangerous agenda.

If you want to end this MAGA nightmare... if you want James Talarico to be the next senator from the state of Texas... if you want to take it to Ken Paxton... this one is for you.
You probably remember that Paxton came after me and Powered by People in the middle of the Texas gerrymandering fight last year.
He sued us not because we’d broken any law, but because he hoped that bringing the full weight of the Attorney General’s office against us would cause us to throw in the towel. He was rightfully worried that our grassroots organizing, voter registration programs and our willingness to fight to the last breath against this attempted authoritarian takeover of our government would cause him problems in his race for Senate.
Maybe, he thought, he could tie us up in courts, force us to rack up unaffordable legal bills, and sideline one of the most innovative voter turnout programs in the country.
It’s what he’s tried to do to other groups across the state. Annunciation House. FIEL Houston. Catholic Charities of the Rio Grande Valley. Jolt Initiative.
He even sued the Democratic donation processing firm ActBlue.
Not because anyone has broken the law. But because he sees them as political opponents.
Here’s the good news. Like us, many of these groups are fighting back. And like us, many of them are winning. ActBlue just won a major decision in federal court last week.
That shows that standing up to a thug like Paxton, fighting back and fighting to win, works. So let’s keep it up. Because, while we’ve won at the district court and appeals court levels, he is not letting up, hoping to wear us down and stop us from organizing.
It hasn't been easy -- we’ve spent more than $500,000 in legal fees fighting him so far -- but it's been possible thanks to contributions from people like you.
[**Please donate today so that we can continue to beat him in court and focus on the work that will elect James Talarico the next U.S. Senator from Texas.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260618.h9qaGS&refcode=ema20260618-240907&t=3&akid=240907%2E444211%2E2LyM1O)

Thank you,
Beto

Peter, This year alone, Governor Bill Lee and Tennessee Republicans pushed some of the most vile, hateful legislation targeting our LGBTQ+ community. They passed a resolution designating June as “Nuclear Family Month”, tried to ban drag performances, and created a list of our trans neighbors. They think this division will make our state better. body:

Welcome to Roy Cooper
Don't recognize this sender? [Unsubscribe with one click](https://substack..NAGzWZSXXFU4sR581NkIZyzVeXZfwqUTDuGd-qKduaA?)
Roy Cooper recently imported your email address from another platform to Substack. You'll now receive their posts via email or the [Substack app](https://substack.com/redirect/17875440-abc3-4666-9ed3-04cfb35fedb9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To set up your profile and discover more on Substack, [click here](https://substack.com/redirect/bca9dc50-c6a9-49f8-b416-4bea815626ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Have you met Michael Whatley yet?
Whatley launched his campaign against Roy Cooper way back in August 2025. But nearly a year later, not many people know who he is yet.
And that's a shame, because there's so much to learn about this guy. So here's what you should know about Michael Whatley.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/327f50ee-1fb0-4f22-a642-0ced7465ba1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Whatley is Donald Trump's handpicked candidate
Back in 2025, when it was rumored that Roy Cooper might run for Senate, the GOP started panicking -- they knew that if Democrats were going to flip North Carolina for the first time since 2008, Roy Cooper was the candidate who could do it.
So Donald Trump stepped in to handpick his very own candidate for NC: the chair of the Republican National Committee, former chair of the NCGOP and Trump's favorite yes-man, Michael Whatley.
### Whatley is the consummate DC Insider
Seriously, if they made a movie about his life, it would probably be called "The Lobbyist." Before Whatley led the NCGOP (where he did everything he could to elect self-described "Black Nazi" Mark Robinson in 2024), he spent his career in the DC swamp.
Michael Whatley with his good friends Mark Robinson (left) and Harvey Lee West (right)
Whatley got his start working as a staffer on Capitol Hill, but before too long, he decided to use his DC connections to lobby for all sorts of big corporations. We're talking Big Oil and even utility companies -- companies exactly like Duke Energy, who just hiked utility rates on North Carolinians. _[It's no wonder Whatley still hasn't denounced Duke's decision to hike rates on customers already struggling with rising costs.](https://substack.com/redirect/d725e8d3-b53a-45d8-ab37-adf6a0a097e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/327f50ee-1fb0-4f22-a642-0ced7465ba1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Whatley repeatedly appointed a convicted child sex offender to NCGOP leadership
Seriously. Harvey Lee West pleaded guilty to multiple counts of taking indecent liberties with children. He served six years in prison, and after he was released, was required to register as a sex offender for over a decade. West's sex offender status received nationwide attention in 2012, when West was forced to resign as an alternate delegate to that year's RNC because of his criminal past.
Despite West's disturbing criminal history being public record and well-known in NCGOP circles, Michael Whatley repeatedly chose to appoint West to committee leadership positions within the NCGOP. Whatley and West attended dozens of party events together, including a fundraising event put on by West at his home.
Even worse? Harvey Lee West has [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/6845a211-02bc-496d-bb54-0cd89535677f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Whatley knew about his past this entire time. But apparently he cared more about power than protecting people.
And this guy says he cares about North Carolina families?
Voters may not know much about Michael Whatley yet, but it's pretty clear: this guy is not fit to be North Carolina's next Senator.
Thank you for reading,
Andy Volosky, Digital Director for Cooper for North Carolina

From the long nights during my deployment in the Middle East to the long days running a small business, I've learned a few hard lessons.

1. Family is everything - I would have given anything to hold my wife, Annie, and hug my baby girl during those long deployments.
2. You only lose when you quit - I could have sold my soul to corporate America when I retired from the Air Force, but instead, I started a small business to support my family and my community.
3. One team, one fight - A leader is only as strong as their team.

Fellow American, JD Vance here.

_I don't email you often._

This isn't just another fundraising pitch.

I value your time and thank you for opening this.

So here's why I'm writing today.

I just came out of a briefing on 2026 midterm turnout projections.

And I'm not going to sugarcoat it, **the numbers alarmed me.**

**Only 61% of Republicans say they're planning to vote in the midterms.**

Read that again. Nearly _4 in 10 Republicans may stay home._

Patriot, if that happens, _if 39% of our base sits out:_

**> >> Democrats take back the House.

>>> They take back the Senate.

>>> And every single thing President Trump has built, every executive order, every America First victory, every fight we've won together gets dismantled piece by piece.**

body:
Meet Abbas Alawieh.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260618-1&t=1&akid=3616%2E587540%2En2hfGG)
Peter, we’ve got big news to announce today:
**We’re endorsing Abbas Alawieh for Michigan’s 2nd State Senate District!**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260618_1_abbas.AVKC2b&refcode=em20260618-3616&amount=5&t=2&akid=3616%2E587540%2En2hfGG)
Abbas is a lifelong Michigander and former congressional Chief of Staff who built a reputation on Capitol Hill as a legislative juggernaut.
Working for progressive champions like Reps. Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib, Abbas authored dozens of bills and amendments that passed the U.S. House.
Now, Abbas is running for Michigan State Senate to put working families first, ensure dignity for our elders, and fight for safety on our roads.
**Abbas’s competitive open primary is coming up fast on August 4.**
**[I’ll tell you more about Abbas, but first, will you split a $5 donation between his campaign and Leaders We Deserve to help power his fight?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260618_1_abbas.AVKC2b&refcode=em20260618-3616&amount=5&t=3&akid=3616%2E587540%2En2hfGG)**
Throughout his career, Abbas has been a champion for change — orchestrating policy action that kept families housed during the pandemic, blocked unjust deportations, and secured billions of dollars to remove toxic lead water distribution pipes.
A public health advocate by training, Abbas moved back home to Michigan to care for his mother after her cancer diagnosis. He saw firsthand how families in need of compassionate care are hit with predatory, life-altering medical bills instead.
In Lansing, Abbas will put working families first. He is ready to fight for affordable childcare, defend economic security programs for seniors and people with disabilities, and pass the MiCare Act for single-payer healthcare in Michigan. He is also ready to tackle traffic fatalities on our roads as a public health crisis, funding real interventions like mass transit and walkable streets rather than relying on carceral systems.
**Abbas is exactly the kind of public servant Leaders We Deserve is proud to support. He doesn’t take a dime of corporate PAC money. Instead, he’s relying on grassroots support from people like you who are tired of the status quo.**
**[Will you make a $5 contribution to Abbas’s campaign and Leaders We Deserve to help us continue electing inspiring young leaders across the country?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260618_1_abbas.AVKC2b&refcode=em20260618-3616&amount=5&t=4&akid=3616%2E587540%2En2hfGG)**
Abbas’s opponent in this open primary is the definition of the corporate-backed status quo.
State Representative Erin Byrnes is heavily bankrolled by massive special interests, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Comcast, and corporate real estate PACs. Her record reflects it: she recently "accidentally" sponsored an anti-diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) bill written by Republicans and marched it right through the House floor.
We cannot send corporate-backed politicians to fight a right-wing machine. We need leaders with real backbone and deep community roots.
District 2 is a safe blue seat, meaning whoever wins this primary wins the seat. Abbas has already secured the backing of Senator Bernie Sanders and local labor unions, but he needs the early resources to counter the corporate money flooding into his opponent's coffers.
**We have a real opportunity to do something big and elect a young progressive leader that will truly fight for the people of his district instead of another establishment-backed corporate sellout._But it will only happen with your support, Peter._**
**[Pitch in $5, split between Abbas and Leaders We Deserve, to join the fight. We can’t do this without you.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260618_1_abbas.AVKC2b&refcode=em20260618-3616&amount=5&t=5&akid=3616%2E587540%2En2hfGG)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260618_1_abbas.AVKC2b&amount=5&refcode=em20260618-3616&t=24&akid=3616%2E587540%2En2hfGG)**
Thank you,
David Hogg
