Iranians walk past a portrait of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei as they participate in a nightly rally marking the Muslim holy month of Muharram in downtown Tehran, Iran, on June 15, 2026. Photo by Morteza Nikoubazl/NurPhoto via Getty Images.
The night before the U.S.-Iran deal was first [digitally](https://substack.com/redirect/2b3c23f1-4ea5-4eee-9488-2518c2c20913?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) signed on June 15, hundreds of demonstrators gathered in the streets of Tehran to denounce the agreement. Protesters outside the Iranian foreign ministry waved placards demanding a resumption of the war, even personally denouncing the lead negotiators of the memorandum of understanding, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Aragchi and parliamentary speaker Mohammed Bagher Qalibaf, as "capitulators" to the country's enemies.
Despite a general consensus favoring the deal, which was signed separately by President Donald Trump in Versailles and by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Tehran on Wednesday, a small yet vocal subset of the Iranian political system has reacted with dismay to the agreement, characterizing it as a strategic mistake and a betrayal of Iranian national interests.
"It seems that they have become more radical than before," Feresteh Sadeghi, a journalist and political analyst based in Tehran, told Drop Site, referring to the protesters. "Their action and protest movement got too much attention and raised alarm bells among authorities in the country, and the security forces as well."
In a statement issued on Thursday, Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei seemed to distance himself from the agreement, saying that he had authorized Iran's political leaders to sign, while suggesting that he personally did not agree with the deal. Stating that he had a "different opinion," Khamenei said that he nonetheless authorized Pezeshkian to go forward after "he explicitly accepted responsibility for it."
The demonstrations in Tehran this week against the agreement were largely driven by supporters of the Front of Islamic Revolution Stability, popularly known by its Persian term, Paydari, an ideologically hardline faction. Paydari has numerous supporters in the Iranian parliament and generally rejects negotiations with the West, believing that Iran can achieve security only through continued confrontation that exhausts the will and capacity of Washington to continue fighting.
Representatives of this trend in Iranian politics also vociferously opposed the signing of the 2015 nuclear deal with the Obama administration, with members of parliament leading protests, threatening negotiators, and even [breaking down in tears](https://substack.com/redirect/df319a8c-19fb-4398-93f0-6d25cbf5b225?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the signing of an agreement that many warned at the time would not be honored and would serve only to lay the groundwork for future U.S. attacks against Iran.
The first Trump administration validated these fears in 2018 by violating the nuclear agreement despite Iranian compliance. Egged on by the Israeli government, Trump pivoted instead to a campaign of sanctions, assassinations, and military attacks against Iran termed as "maximum pressure." That campaign failed to topple the government, but it did transform the Iranian political system--discrediting reformists and galvanizing the conservatives now leading street marches denouncing the prospect of a new deal with Washington.
The terms of the MOU include a permanent halt to the fighting on all fronts, including Lebanon, as well as commitments to end sanctions on the Iranian economy and direct foreign investment into the country, in exchange for Iranian commitments to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and that it will not develop a nuclear weapon. Detailed discussions about the Iranian nuclear program and permanent reintegration of Tehran into the global economy will take place over a 60 day period that is "extendable with mutual consent."
Despite a broad public perception that the deal is favorable to Iran, and even represents a capitulation by Trump, opponents inside Iran have argued that the agreement actually places serious burdens on Tehran and sets the stage for future American attacks.
Mahmoud Nabavian, a member of parliament from Tehran, has given a series of television interviews opposing the agreement and explaining what he describes as an unfair sequencing of Iranian commitments. Nabavian described the deal on social media as a "pure loss" for the country. "Victory can only be achieved through resistance," Nabavian said in public comments the day the MOU was digitally signed. "With the current approach, no victory has been won and the threat of war will not be removed from the country."
Despite such dissent, supporters of the deal remain firmly in the drivers' seat of policymaking. In a series of audio messages, Mahdi Mohammadi, an advisor to Ghalibaf, explained the relative benefits of the agreement, seeking to assuage critics' concerns and comparing the MOU favorably to the 2015 nuclear deal, saying the war had given Iran powerful leverage to ensure that the U.S. would not renege on its commitments once again.
"The strait is in our hands, we can close it any time we want," Mohammadi said, adding that unlike in 2015, the Gulf Arab countries have now also been forced to compromise with Iran, including through investments and repatriation of frozen Iranian funds intended to prevent the resumption of a war that had devastated their own economies.
These arguments appear to have been broadly convincing, even as the threat of war continues to loom over Iran after two sneak attacks by the U.S. and Israel over the past two years.
"I think the Israelis will do their best, perhaps even abetted by the neocons in Washington, to reignite the war somehow," Ali Kolahi, former chairman of Iran's Industry Commission in the Iranian Chamber of Commerce, told Drop Site. "But I also think the leaders of the country think that if the U.S. tries to go for the jugular again, we can again close the Strait of Hormuz and go for horizontal escalation. We may have other bits and pieces that we haven't yet shown."
While the original nuclear agreement made with the Obama administration was sold as the first step towards a broader reconciliation with the West, the new arrangement is being presented to supporters of the government as a purely pragmatic arrangement--entered into with "no trust" towards Washington and a continued readiness to return to armed confrontation if necessary, thus avoiding the perceived mistakes of the pro-Western reformist camp.
"The liberal camp has definitely lost the narrative in Iran compared to 2015, when they kind of had the upper hand and they were able to execute some of their policies, some of their more West-leaning, more conciliatory policies. We saw what came out of that, the U.S. did not respect any of that, and they attacked Iran," said Navid Zarrinal, a political analyst and historian based in Tehran. "The biggest concern is essentially their naivete about the nature of the West.
We talk to a lot of these liberals. They say that if Iranians just stop saying 'death to America' and act like a normal country, everything would be resolved. But that's not the case."
Zarrinal explained, "We saw it with Syria--Syria basically surrendered to U.S. and Israeli demands, but Israel still bombed their defensive infrastructure. If the moderates get their way, I can guarantee you that Israel would still bomb Iran's defensive infrastructure the next day."
## **Economic Pressure**
A major factor pushing even a government heavily influenced by the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) to seek detente with the U.S. is the [dire economic condition](https://substack.com/redirect/b6b0347d-4c6f-4fde-b0db-cfa5524880ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) inside Iran after years of sanctions and the destruction of Iranian civilian infrastructure during the recent war. Several million Iranians are believed to have lost their jobs directly or indirectly as a result of the recent fighting, blockade, and internet shutdown. The International Monetary Fund now projects that Iran's GDP will contract by 6% in 2026, with consumer prices rising nearly 70% during the same period.
The Iranian economy is dominated by a network of semi-governmental institutions with ties to the security establishment. These firms largely control the flow of imports, exports, and energy resources, and are also tasked with navigating the complex web of sanctions the country faces when trading abroad and repatriating funds from the sale of oil and gas.
For conservative skeptics of the MOU, who doubt the deal will bring a durable end to the war, these powerful business conglomerates are seen as the forces pressing the government hardest to move forward. Known in Persian as "khusulati"--a blend of the words for "private" and "government"--these firms stand to regain access to billions of dollars of frozen funds, as well as new business opportunities in Iran's oligarchical economy.
"It is likely they were behind the scenes pushing for an agreement because their trade and business interests had been jeopardized, especially in the UAE. We know that in the first weeks of the war, the UAE had confiscated their money and shut off access to their bank accounts. They are the ones who wanted this deal so their business returns to normal, and authorities listen to them because they have power in the economy," said Sadeghi, in reference to the "khusulati" firms. "Ordinary people or even politicians who oppose this deal or memorandum of understanding are the ones who don't have any financial interest in this matter."
Sadeghi added that she believes that despite the seemingly attractive promises of economic relief contained in the MOU, past experience, including attacks on Iran during negotiations in 2025 and 2026, suggests the two countries will fail to find a final detente that settles the conflict or permanently lifts sanctions.
"I personally think that Iran and the United States will not reach any agreement whatsoever," she said, adding that the U.S. was "addicted to sanctions and bullying."
## **Polarization or Sedition**
While the Iranian government has engaged in successive waves of crackdowns against liberal and monarchist opponents, ethnic separatists, and even disillusioned conservative political figures, the tensions with the small group of committed opponents of the current agreement with Washington may lead to a rare confrontation with a segment of the political system to its right.
Members of the broad political establishment who support the deal have warned against further public dissent, characterizing recent demonstrations as an attempt to create unrest in a country still reeling from a failed uprising that killed thousands in January. "Mossad is awake at night to create sedition," said Hesamodin Ashna, an advisor to former President Hassan Rouhani in a public statement seen as a warning to opponents of the MOU. "Do not polarize society, Do not camp on the street."
For the time being, proponents of the agreement appear likely to continue the peace negotiations with Washington.
The agreement, which will also require the U.S. to pressure Israel to end its assault on Lebanon, now depends on whether Iran has successfully created enough deterrence through its missile attacks and closure of the strait to prevent Trump from resuming the war later in his term.
"If Trump doesn't experience real pain, he will be planning for his next attack," said Dr. Foad Izadi, a professor at the University of Tehran, explaining the perspective of Iranian opponents of the deal. "What this faction wants to see is for the pain to be great enough that next time someone in the White House argues for an attack on Iran, he will be ignored."

Last week, I launched Equal Opportunity Now — and the response has meant more to me than I can say.

That the kid with the hard-to-pronounce name still gets a shot. That this country should be there for the next family that needs it — just like it was there for mine.
We're going after the fights that matter most to working families. Lowering costs. Strengthening workers' rights. Holding corrupt politicians and corporate bad actors accountable. Fighting bigotry in all its forms. And electing the bold, ambitious leaders who will take on Trump's MAGA agenda and actually deliver.
We're just getting started. And I need your help to close our first quarter strong.
June 30th is our first FEC deadline — the first real signal we send to the political world about whether Equal Opportunity Now has the grassroots muscle to back up its mission. I need 24 donations before midnight on June 30th to hit our goal.

|
Peter,
Recently, clips of Trump storming out of an interview with NBC reporter Kristen Welker of Meet the Press went viral.
During the interview, after pushback from Welker on Trump's claims that elections are rigged, he completely lost it--taking off his microphone, spiking it into the ground, stomping on it, calling Welker "crooked or stupid," and then storming off the set.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-DExh8TOe3PSQT3frCu91ejQMk4_K4yoW9C9DzaDWGAYWQoZlfjNDUOYQlbRcAQOqG-BTlORDLySZf9YW98BvBMLaRyGQ_7jlDZfjrZLXI52cWy7eqAAZvIl2195J4-1MiW5Px5m_UwR0KXePhIXz__ORg0Iq-irbHGInzfCnW66dyg_Bv991k9d4lIL703j9v9nk_X_C01Nt-cleWTwVQZLOGQb9ltn2ZiB5L5DqQk=&c=RAjZ8BiD5WZAt-PgTuOTuNwPoEXQhLS3wyhu3vxO4Qr9KmAXpBxwxQ==&ch=K48-HGAqP58h6nvdLvlNTNN9qVd7kNlgFHrokrXmhCWOjgx6uMTQRQ==)
---

This latest episode is just further evidence of Donald Trump's unraveling and it's becoming increasingly violent and dangerous.
He has suspicious bruises on his hands, swollen ankles, and has routinely made visits to Walter Reed hospital for undisclosed reasons. He has bragged about passing multiple "cognitive tests" during the past two years, not realizing he's admitting something far more damning. Doctors don't administer cognitive tests that frequently to check if you're fine. They do it to track how fast you're declining.
He now routinely falls asleep on camera during White House events during the day, while posting hundreds of times on social media throughout the night into early morning hours--posting AI generated pictures of himself as Jesus, threatening to wipe out the enitre Iranian civilization, and so much more.
Early in May, 36 prominent doctors signed a letter warning about Trump's "rapidly worsening, reality-untethered, increasingly dangerous decline." They urged cabinet officials to limit his access to the nuclear codes and called on them to invoke the 25th amendment:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-DExh8TOe3PSQT3frCu91ejQMk4_K4yoW9C9DzaDWGAYWQoZlfjNDUOYQlbRcAQOqG-BTlORDLySZf9YW98BvBMLaRyGQ_7jlDZfjrZLXI52cWy7eqAAZvIl2195J4-1MiW5Px5m_UwR0KXePhIXz__ORg0Iq-irbHGInzfCnW66dyg_Bv991k9d4lIL703j9v9nk_X_C01Nt-cleWTwVUhVQxOmQlKopSXnKGQ-6NY=&c=RAjZ8BiD5WZAt-PgTuOTuNwPoEXQhLS3wyhu3vxO4Qr9KmAXpBxwxQ==&ch=K48-HGAqP58h6nvdLvlNTNN9qVd7kNlgFHrokrXmhCWOjgx6uMTQRQ==)

This is why Defend Our Courts is preparing a firewall against Trump's most insidious ambitions. We won't hold our breath and hope for the sycophants surrounding Trump to save us.
Trump is declining, and that makes him more dangerous, not less. An unhinged president with a grudge and nothing left to lose is pulling every lever he can to rig the midterms, cement his legacy, and make his vision for America permanent before the clock runs out.
That's why we're fighting on every front. We're defending and building majorities on state Supreme Courts, the courts with final say over election laws in their states. We're paving the path to reform and rebalance the U.S. Supreme Court by backing Democrats in key House and Senate races this November. And we're doing it all at a scale we've never attempted before.
This fight will be expensive and hard, but it's the only fight that matters. If you believe a declining, desperate Trump is a danger to Democracy, we need you on our side today. clean_body: Trump is declining, and that makes him more dangerous, not less. | | | | | == | Peter, Recently, clips of Trump storming out of an interview with NBC reporter Kristen Welker of Meet the Press went viral. During the interview, after pushback from Welker on Trump's claims that elections are rigged, he completely lost it--taking off his microphone, spiking it into the ground, stomping on it, calling Welker "crooked or stupid," and then storming off the set. | == This latest episode is just further evidence of Donald Trump's unraveling and it's becoming increasingly violent and dangerous. He has suspicious bruises on his hands, swollen ankles, and has routinely made visits to Walter Reed hospital for undisclosed reasons. He has bragged about passing multiple "cognitive tests" during the past two years, not realizing he's admitting something far more damning. Doctors don't administer cognitive tests that frequently to check if you're fine. They do it to track how fast you're declining. He now routinely falls asleep on camera during White House events during the day, while posting hundreds of times on social media throughout the night into early morning hours--posting AI generated pictures of himself as Jesus, threatening to wipe out the enitre Iranian civilization, and so much more. Early in May, 36 prominent doctors signed a letter warning about Trump's "rapidly worsening, reality-untethered, increasingly dangerous decline." They urged cabinet officials to limit his access to the nuclear codes and called on them to invoke the 25th amendment: | == This is why Defend Our Courts is preparing a firewall against Trump's most insidious ambitions. We won't hold our breath and hope for the sycophants surrounding Trump to save us. Trump is declining, and that makes him more dangerous, not less. An unhinged president with a grudge and nothing left to lose is pulling every lever he can to rig the midterms, cement his legacy, and make his vision for America permanent before the clock runs out. That's why we're fighting on every front. We're defending and building majorities on state Supreme Courts, the courts with final say over election laws in their states. We're paving the path to reform and rebalance the U.S. Supreme Court by backing Democrats in key House and Senate races this November. And we're doing it all at a scale we've never attempted before. This fight will be expensive and hard, but it's the only fight that matters. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

clean_body: Make your first gift today and receive a FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Friend,I want to start with two simple words. Thank you. Thank you for caring about children you may never meet. Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. Every day. God's children are not for sale. And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: "No more." Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity. And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself. A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold. Families were being torn apart. Lives were being destroyed. I couldn't forget it. I couldn't stay silent. I kept asking myself one question: "What if it were my child?" That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom. Not for fame. Not for awards. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed. Studios walked away. People told us to give up. But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option. And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: To stop the sale of God's children. Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is precious in God's eyes. Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth. And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them When you make your first gift today, you help: Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children. Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation. Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children. Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis. Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers. This is how change happens. One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.**Today, that person can be you. Will you make your first gift now? Choose your shirt size and select a color. And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most. Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. Thank you for choosing action over silence. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. They want to:
📮 Restrict access to mail-in ballots.
⌚ Shorten early voting periods.
🗳️ Move and eliminate Election Day voting centers.
**Their actions are unacceptable, and I refuse to stand by and watch our freedoms be flushed down the drain.**
That is why it's so important we get the _Free, Fair, and Secure Elections Act_ on the ballot in November, pass it, and enshrine the right to vote whenever and wherever in Arizona’s Constitution.

Do you agree that only American citizens should vote in our elections? I’m surveying 600 patriots across the country and still haven't heard from you. Let me tell you why your input is crucial. Right now, Chuck Schumer and Democrats in Washington are working around the clock to make sure illegal aliens who have never paid a dime in taxes, never pledged allegiance to this flag, and have no legal right to be here – can vote in our elections. That's not an exaggeration. That's their goal. They've killed every effort to verify citizenship. They've sued states that cleaned their voter rolls. They've called commonsense ID requirements a civil rights violation. And when you ask them why, they do not have an answer. The Save America Act is straightforward: it requires voter ID & proof of citizenship. That's it. Let me be clear, it does not take away access to voting for any legal, law-abiding American. President Trump has demanded action in this fight. The American people have demanded it. And I am fighting for it every single day. That's where you come in. Fellow Conservative, I’m asking you to to show every Senator standing in the way that this isn't a political talking point — it's a mandate from the American people. This very short**very short, three-question survey** covers a range of the latest critical issues facing Judicial Watch and our nation and will only take you 1-2 minutes to complete. Your answers will not only ensure your voice will be heard in our planning processes... **They will help guide Judicial Watch as we continue our fight for:**
* Clean voter rolls and honest elections.
* Full enforcement of federal election law.
* Immigration law enforcement and an end to sanctuary policies.

And...
* Maximum government transparency.
* Accountability for Deep State corruption and lawfare.

Friend,

Father’s Day is close.

Like clockwork, dads across America will get their “World’s Best Dad” mug. Maybe a tie. And their one good day of appreciation.

Then Monday arrives, and the culture goes right back to treating fatherhood like a punchline.

That's not good enough. Not for our kids, and not for our country.

When my son was born, something shifted in me. I looked at him and felt the full weight of what it means to be a father — the responsibility, the privilege, the stakes.

And then I looked at the culture around us. What I saw alarmed me. Fathers being mocked and marginalized. Boys growing up without strong male role models. A media environment soaked in fear, grievance, and identity politics that had no place for a positive, heroic vision of what a man and a father could be.

I knew something had to change. So I started _Dad Saves America_.

I'm John Papola, Co-Founder and CEO of Emergent Order Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit. I'm also the host of the show I just told you about, _Dad Saves America_ , which is really more of a mission.

Every week, we deliver powerful cultural analysis, deep dive interviews, and investigative documentaries to inform and inspire a growing movement of men who embrace their heroic calling as father figures.

Fatherhood is the greatest opportunity most men will ever have to make a positive impact on the next generation.

And the data proves it.

Father absence is one of the most reliable predictors of poverty, addiction, and incarceration.

Children who grow up with engaged, present fathers are more likely to succeed academically, emotionally, and economically.

**Fatherhood is not a cultural relic. It is a public good. And right now, it is under-discussed and undervalued.**

_Dad Saves America_ is working to change that.

_Dad Saves America_ exists to replace that toxic cultural noise with something better: real conversations about heroic fatherhood.

We talk to fathers, thinkers, coaches, and leaders who are living out a family-first vision of manhood. We push back on the polarization and fear-mongering with honesty, purpose, and a little humor. **And we remind fathers everywhere that they are not the problem — they are the answer.**

Your gift to Emergent Order Foundation funds the production, outreach, and growth of _Dad Saves America_ so we can reach more fathers and help them be the strong, engaged, heroic figures their families need. And their one good day of appreciation. Then Monday arrives, and the culture goes right back to treating fatherhood like a punchline. That's not good enough. Not for our kids, and not for our country. When my son was born, something shifted in me. I looked at him and felt the full weight of what it means to be a father — the responsibility, the privilege, the stakes. And then I looked at the culture around us. What I saw alarmed me. Fathers being mocked and marginalized. Boys growing up without strong male role models. A media environment soaked in fear, grievance, and identity politics that had no place for a positive, heroic vision of what a man and a father could be. I knew something had to change. So I started Dad Saves America. I'm John Papola, Co-Founder and CEO of Emergent Order Foundation, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit. I'm also the host of the show I just told you about, Dad Saves America , which is really more of a mission. Every week, we deliver powerful cultural analysis, deep dive interviews, and investigative documentaries to inform and inspire a growing movement of men who embrace their heroic calling as father figures. Fatherhood is the greatest opportunity most men will ever have to make a positive impact on the next generation. And the data proves it. Father absence is one of the most reliable predictors of poverty, addiction, and incarceration. Children who grow up with engaged, present fathers are more likely to succeed academically, emotionally, and economically. Fatherhood is not a cultural relic. It is a public good. And right now, it is under-discussed and undervalued. Dad Saves America is working to change that. Dad Saves America exists to replace that toxic cultural noise with something better: real conversations about heroic fatherhood. We talk to fathers, thinkers, coaches, and leaders who are living out a family-first vision of manhood. We push back on the polarization and fear-mongering with honesty, purpose, and a little humor. And we remind fathers everywhere that they are not the problem — they are the answer. Your gift to Emergent Order Foundation funds the production, outreach, and growth of Dad Saves America so we can reach more fathers and help them be the strong, engaged, heroic figures their families need. Fellow American,

My name is Mike Carey. I'm a Congressman from Ohio, and I sit on the Ways and Means Committee, the committee that controls tax policy and how your hard-earned dollars get spent.

I took an oath to protect this country and the people who fund it. _I take that seriously._

So when the Left tried to hit every working American family with the largest tax increase in our nation's history — _I fought to stop it._

When billions in taxpayer dollars were flowing out the door with zero accountability — _I fought to fix it._

When workers told me they couldn't keep up — _I fought to eliminate taxes on their tips and their overtime, so they could keep more of what they earned._

subject: The Mountain Minute: 6/18/2026 + a message from Larry Gatlin!
body:
ICE detention cases are surging in Colorado. The DOJ keeps losing the legal fight.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
_**Country music legend Larry Gatlin is headed to Castle Rock for Freedom Fest and you HAVE to hear the most adorable message he left for you, our readers!**_
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Larry promises a gathering of "happy warriors" celebrating America, freedom, and Colorado alongside an incredible lineup of speakers, entertainers, and special guests. Don't miss your chance to be part of one of the biggest patriotic celebrations of the year.
**A couple reminders:** ✅ Thanks to generous donors, we're offering a limited number of sponsored Freedom Fest tickets for Gold Star Families, veterans, active-duty military, and first responders. _**[Click here to nominate someone!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ ✅ Volunteer at Freedom Fest and receive a complimentary Silver Pass ($95 value). _**[Sign up today](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ and help make this unforgettable event a success!
_**Tickets now start at just $45. Kids under 17 and under come for FREE!**_
**[June 26-27 | Douglas County Fairgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
🎟️ **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**ONLY 8 DAYS AWAY!**
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, June 18, 2026.
– Team RMV
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Lara Logan: Why ordinary people still give her hope](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A few weeks after walking out of a Colorado prison, Tina Peters will take the stage at RMV Freedom Fest. Lara Logan will follow her to the microphone.
After decades covering wars, terrorism, government corruption and some of the biggest stories in the world, Logan still talks most about people like Peters.
A county clerk. A whistleblower. A parent standing before a school board. An ordinary person who decides staying quiet is no longer an option.
“People like Tina Peters ... she was just a mom,” Logan said. Logan is no stranger to the state. Over the past several years, Colorado has kept showing up in her reporting through Tina Peters’ case and the election-integrity disputes that followed.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.** Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. _America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._ Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[ICE detention cases are surging in Colorado. The DOJ keeps losing the legal fight.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **A 2025 Board of Immigration Appeals ruling eliminating bond hearings for those present without formal admission triggered the flood:** Colorado judges have granted 248 petitions challenging the policy, with only one judge — Chief Judge Daniel Domenico — consistently ruling for the government.

* **A Tenth Circuit fee ruling turned the litigation into a self-funding machine:** attorneys who win immigration habeas cases across six states can now bill federal taxpayers for fees — prompting a Westminster nonprofit to hire dedicated staff and the Colorado Bar Association to host free training on filing petitions and recovering those fees.

* **Colorado taxpayers are also funding the legal infrastructure upstream:** the state's Immigrant Legal Defense Fund — grown to $700,000 — helps fund detention work at Aurora, while the Tenth Circuit has yet to rule on whether the underlying policy is valid law — a decision that could either shut down the surge or cement it.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
_**Looking for a way to make a difference in your community?**_ Join the **Precinct Project USA National Call on Monday, June 22 at 1:00 PM EST** and/or the **Election Integrity Call at 2:00 PM EST**. and learn how grassroots citizens are getting involved at the local level to strengthen civic engagement and election integrity. Hosted by Steve Stern and featuring leaders from across the country, the call will focus on practical ways to become active in your precinct, connect with like-minded neighbors, and help shape the future of your community.
Whether you're a longtime volunteer or just getting started, this is a great opportunity to learn, connect, and take action. The event will be streamed live on the [Stern American Rumble channel](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Temper, temper](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY MARK SALLEY | COMMENTARY | JUNE 17** _The Left is having a temper tantrum over America250. The babysitters spent the last 10 to 20 years...letting the children do exactly what they wanted. The children didn’t like mommy’s and daddy’s rules. So the babysitters, rather than enforcing the time-tested rules, let the children break them. And, break the rules they did. They left behind civility, honesty and responsibility._
__
**[Colorado rebuilt how it votes twice. Its federal plan never caught up.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JUNE 16** _Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold has called the state’s switch to mail-in voting a transformation of democracy. The federal election plan Colorado keeps on file describes an election system mostly built around precinct polling places. Both come from the state. One appeared in a 2023 news release celebrating the 10th anniversary of Colorado’s vote-by-mail law._
**[Colorado is cutting funding for its poorest students. The tool meant to replace it was suspended.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 16** _In Colorado’s smallest school districts, the ones tucked into rural towns, two state programs direct extra money each year to districts based on how many students live in poverty. They are not a lot, but they are specific. They are meant for those kids. And they are going away._
__

---

This Juneteenth, let’s work to close the racial wealth gap and invest in Black communities. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWb0Un6XC-giORQB3AbCzekJ4xXyqKOaESxw8snUr26nzKqAYSRSyAPnQsHiZSuJJC0p8ZxUQmYSWR9PnHViI611u9_X6WPzbqnL7MNBa0pBL7lnuYvfvnWWwovJMFJJyG-XUAQ1UA8uVi7aj-0MzRejF-4JtOymAsax7DycDamOs/4rl/XtNiyDTRTzqqPnPqe0WIRg/h0/h001.vfEKG2ROzSUHzZpw7NqT8iNpPpwMSNGsbZFBZXOpIJo)

Friend, Tomorrow is Juneteenth, marking 161 years since Black Americans won freedom from slavery. Black Americans have continued to lead movements for liberation, including in my hometown of Detroit. **I’m committed to the ongoing struggle for Black liberation and equity—including working to close the ever-widening racial wealth gap, secure reparations for descendants of enslaved Black Americans, and invest in Black communities.** For example, Black American homeowners pay an average of 10-13 percent more in property taxes. It’s even worse in my majority-Black hometown of Detroit, where our discriminatory property tax system taxes the _least_ expensive homes _six times_ _more_ than the _most_ expensive homes. **The Black-led nonprofit organization Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance helps rectify this injustice and keeps people housed** by supporting lower-income residents in applying for property tax exemptions and assistance. Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance**also helps residents of redlined neighborhoods with much-needed home repairs and revitalization projects.** From fixing and replacing leaking roofs and aging furnaces to upgrading homes for seniors’ safety and independence, CRCAA helps people **lower their utility bills** , age with dignity and safety in their homes, and have a higher quality of life without getting priced out. [**Can you invest in Black communities and combat redlining this Juneteenth by chipping in to Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWrjRMYQAM61uVShIC9CHVUKZYAF9NKkCC0b2rLG0wDuMXPMIRzBRQxBYH9Gr83Lda0fCJuq7kz9cQCgXVXt_IjJ4dcPjBim51S_0hc6OmGbrdwPAH9FTiKFoZm-3L4vMWT5Nn9GmcbK2U7ux3QuPrLEgn1vcNTeTntIWK1mwJWGUmEo7JiHxnTTF8zphWh_Vy6B_cRh2YhT-XEEocHQfDiV6LQeQ_mQ3KgezEoqVWposbyJ2M4caqD502A7_EWG3x-dIXp_hKQCqhqO6btZmbc/4rl/XtNiyDTRTzqqPnPqe0WIRg/h1/h001.WDyMP-FQfrqT5gXUtN3HG20BGbRrU5Euy6VUVPRHnvk) | [SUPPORT THIS BLACK-LED NONPROFIT](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWrjRMYQAM61uVShIC9CHVUKZYAF9NKkCC0b2rLG0wDuiXHvXbMPFwXbhcV7gEvhnV8cbPCrsri5roy5E3FKUVwgfAN_MxoyKAcvw93nIAduo7cV9EBHEDcIuLODCd1iSLQ6hOOQiP5R5ymKou0ENPr_JyNVjrSGRITz_WVkQTYHcX0GQfgpRptE0q8cl_DZ1iQkG_D4bf6ECrgE5Z63SieAI8mEFYf6XWg6r6vD-LzVdWKhVGKWkpn5b-_iqaL-1nTRIBDXsPcJHQG9YI4-MlM/4rl/XtNiyDTRTzqqPnPqe0WIRg/h2/h001.oyaD7k0co3AeT4HpVP9ZAQm4v5QOEy2X_UEIEcYwWMo)
---
Led by community members, Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance (CRCAA) has convened over 700 community meetings and hosted hundreds of community planning sessions, deeply involving residents in the process of shaping and strengthening their neighborhoods.
CRCAA **encourages young people’s involvement in decision-making** and community-building with:
* a Youth Council of community advocates between 13 and 20 years old
* a Leadership Initiative for high school students
* a wellness space for teens
* a career development and job readiness training program
* a Voices of Youth journalism and artist program
* a paid education and work experience program for 14- to 24-year-olds who learn life skills such as financial literacy

CRCAA also **helps our seasoned residents live independently** through computer education and support for seniors who are caregivers—in addition to home repairs and upgrades such as installing new handrails, grab bars, and motion detector lights.
And at least three times a year, Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance canvasses door to door throughout Far West Detroit, connecting residents with resources such as mental health support and free food distribution.
The government has chronically disinvested in Black communities, making mutual aid and community groups like Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance even more necessary. Especially now, with ongoing cuts to federally funded programs, those of us who can afford to donate should send our money to organizations rooted in our communities.
[**If you can, please make a contribution to Cody Rouge Community Action Alliance for Juneteenth.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWrjRMYQAM61uVShIC9CHVUKZYAF9NKkCC0b2rLG0wDuzE-Uh1Q1W3Irgt9k1AxNb_iOdeHaCMW1oItQoT8xLSpjSIk2LboXVK0zde3KEj90UaHMU7iEW0JELS01qevp2VDbF8-YLgSD1sKAozys7rnx1Y8pnjQiDrngh6pYkagr0LGWybxWWQbuLCKNT262xGtpyNZD1omfbTWgl3fzJZDS00PC9JT8ZuE4afJeyBDZITkznioRP1-Yje9gJNq24aUXjiZwb1f64DL_-RhA468/4rl/XtNiyDTRTzqqPnPqe0WIRg/h3/h001.sTWH8TmUN64pmFfANVSXxZBAN8YDJCDKi_6Yhl6GIC0)
[CHIP IN](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWrjRMYQAM61uVShIC9CHVUKZYAF9NKkCC0b2rLG0wDuDt24u413RQyWkPQ1JgAmZpj-2oRhjbyp5UWN2NMERwvWkDWQUrKtwv6JpKcUspwx0aKINLVYDOmS8ZUyoj92geH7ZK6LlKC5yTSUXhz7vbvKVfMP-4uFVzxVmAwToOEEIENUSYyT_ZZky7XHlxXymp2aQC26HggRrRuUgH1sRqrHq7mEseBF602DAf-MSwz3RlqSCCU0xt9bQFlkCDCuiT2rdsUeYdt0_12pNmQH_NU/4rl/XtNiyDTRTzqqPnPqe0WIRg/h4/h001.09JxkiS8Caiu4unrkSxbJkb_zaGREnFzdwc5Di3_ZvU)

Thank you so much. I promise to keep pushing to dismantle systemic racism and working toward a multi-racial democracy—where our leaders actually listen to us and everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
In Congress, I’ve passed legislation to address racial inequities, including expanding Black homeownership and ending banks’ denial of small-dollar mortgage loans, banning medical debt from appearing on credit reports, funding home repairs to keep people in their homes, stopping water shutoffs, and addressing our country’s crisis of lead poisoning**.**
I’m also leading legislation to end environmental racism and poverty, strengthen civil rights enforcement laws, and defend the 14th Amendment, which established Black Americans’ constitutional right to vote through birthright citizenship as well as due process and equal protection under the law.
Generations of Americans have fought to secure the full promise of freedom and equality, and we aren’t stopping now.
With you in the fight for Black liberation, racial justice, and equity for all,
Rashida

| | Recently, the U.S. Postal Service announced it would only deliver mail-in ballots to states that share their voter lists with the Trump administration so it can create a national voter database. **This is a shameful cave-in to a failing president who's shown he'll do anything to suppress democracy.** Oregon has been voting by mail for over 30 years. Mail-in voting is safe, easy, and efficient. It results in higher voter turnout, and contrary to what Donald Trump wants everyone to believe, has lower fraud rates of any voting system in the country. Since he took office last year, Trump has been trying his hardest to suppress voting ahead of consequential midterm elections this November. subject: quick question about social security
body:

Derek, Ted Cruz admitted what we’ve been suspecting all along: Donald Trump and Republicans are on a mission to gut Americans’ hard-earned Social Security benefits. **Trump and his allies are continuing a decades-long push for personal accounts — now called Trump Accounts — as a way to privatize Social Security and undermine American seniors.** Social Security serves as a lifeline for millions of older Americans who rely on the program to retire with dignity after decades of hard work. That’s why Trump and Republicans seem determined to target it. You may have noticed I skipped the state Democratic convention this weekend, and that was a deliberate choice.
The most important thing I can do between now and August is stay rooted right here in the district, shaking hands and hearing folks out, because the people of the 7th are the whole reason I am doing this in the first place.
I did record a video for the convention, though, and you can watch it right here.

subject: $3 — that’s it
body:
_Billionaire Rick Jackson spent $120 million to win the Republican nomination for Governor._
**I'm writing to ask for $3.**
No, that's not a typo.
Rick Jackson says he’s going to be "President Trump's favorite governor,” so we need all hands on deck right now. **[Will you donate $3 right now to me and Wes Moore to help launch the next phase of this campaign and flip Georgia blue?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/1435?c0=wes-em-20260618-2.P7VvVL&refcode=em-20260618&t=1&akid=1519%2E1086043%2EmZp_MQ)**
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/1435?c0=wes-em-20260618-2.P7VvVL&refcode=em-20260618&t=2&akid=1519%2E1086043%2EmZp_MQ)**
Look, after spending $120 million trying to buy this election, Jackson is already preparing to spend millions more to buy the Governor's Mansion.
But you might be thinking – $3 isn't very much money. How can we stand up to a billionaire with $3?
That's the point.
This campaign _isn’t_ powered by billionaires. It's powered by thousands of people chipping in what they can because they believe Georgia deserves a governor who will fight for them.
And when thousands of people chip in just a few dollars, we can build something powerful.
* Your $3 helps us organize in communities across the state.
* Your $3 helps us reach voters before Rick Jackson's attack ads do.
* Your $3 sends a message that Georgia belongs to its people—not the wealthy politicians trying to buy it.

If everyone reading this email gave just $3, we'd raise the resources we need to compete with Rick Jackson's fortune and hit tonight's fundraising goal.
**[So please: Will you make a contribution of $3 (or more, if you can!) to help defeat Rick Jackson and elect the first Democratic Governor of Georgia this century?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/1435?c0=wes-em-20260618-2.P7VvVL&refcode=em-20260618&t=3&akid=1519%2E1086043%2EmZp_MQ)**

Thank you for being part of this team.
— Keisha Lance Bottoms

If other countries can build fast, reliable rail, so can we.
Seth’s vision for transportation and infrastructure in the region is expansive and inclusive. It means finally building West-East Rail to modern, high-speed standards, so a trip between Boston and Springfield could take closer to 40 minutes instead of eating up half the day. It also means building New England Crossrail, so trains can move through Boston instead of forcing the whole region to move around an outdated system. These projects would greatly open economic opportunities for communities along the rail line, and allow for better job placement, therefore increasing employment opportunities across the state.
This is not some fantasy: it is what modern infrastructure looks like in much of the rest of the world.
Massachusetts should be leading on this, not sitting in traffic and pretending the current system is good enough.

clean_body: Seth wants to build something better. | | Hey friend, Massachusetts spends way too much time sitting in traffic. In 2023, Bostonians experienced some of the worst congestion in the country, and the city was ranked among the worst in the world for traffic. While many just complain about but accept the status quo, Seth knows we can do better. = | = If other countries can build fast, reliable rail, so can we. Seth’s vision for transportation and infrastructure in the region is expansive and inclusive. It means finally building West-East Rail to modern, high-speed standards, so a trip between Boston and Springfield could take closer to 40 minutes instead of eating up half the day. It also means building New England Crossrail, so trains can move through Boston instead of forcing the whole region to move around an outdated system. These projects would greatly open economic opportunities for communities along the rail line, and allow for better job placement, therefore increasing employment opportunities across the state. This is not some fantasy: it is what modern infrastructure looks like in much of the rest of the world. I want to take a minute to explain something that my team talks about a lot and that I think every supporter deserves to understand.

You've probably seen us mention our FEC deadline. But what does that actually mean?

The Federal Election Commission (FEC) requires every campaign to publicly report how much money they've raised at the end of every quarter. On June 30th, we file our next report. And on July 15th, those numbers go public for the entire world to see.

Here's why that matters:

**Donors watch it.** The grassroots fundraising numbers in that report signal whether this campaign has real momentum. Strong numbers attract more support while weak numbers raise doubts about this campaign's viability.

**Analysts watch it.** Political analysts use FEC filings to evaluate how competitive a race really is. A strong report keeps MI-03 on the map as a defended seat. A weak one could shift the narrative further in Republicans' favor.

**Our opponents watch it.** The DeVos family and the GOP machine will be watching our numbers closely. If they see a gap, they’ll pour even more money into this race. If they see a strong grassroots operation, it sends a message that this seat will not be handed over without a fight.

# **Jeffrey Epstein sought leniency by offering dirt on Trump - But came up empty**
Jeffrey Epstein's attorneys **[discussed a potential"proffer" arrangement](https://substack.com/redirect/f712b79c-e5ea-4cfa-8dc6-3a108a3f1a19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with federal prosecutors after his 2019 arrest, in which he would have provided information on other defendants in exchange for a lighter sentence, according to a New York Times report. Notes show Epstein was particularly fixated on offering details about Trump, though his actual comments were vague and unsubstantive -- calling Trump a "total con artist" who "never had money." It remains unclear how far these negotiations progressed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f712b79c-e5ea-4cfa-8dc6-3a108a3f1a19?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The reporting is part of a broader Times investigation into Epstein 's death,** which concludes suicide remains the most plausible explanation despite longstanding alternative theories. New evidence includes Epstein previously asking a cellmate how to fashion a noose, suspicious sounds heard by a nearby inmate the night he died, and handwritten notes echoing language from his alleged suicide note. Several prison lapses -- including no cellmate, extra linens, and infrequent guard rounds -- apparently made his death easier to carry out, their investigation reports.
* **Separately, DOJ-released emails show Epstein remained preoccupied with Trump for years** after their falling out, repeatedly positioning himself as an expert on Trump's thinking to figures including Bill Gates, while privately disparaging the president as "dumb" without being able to implicate him in wrongdoing.

French conservative activist Thais d'Escoeuffant, 26, is awaiting a court verdict after **[being prosecuted](https://substack.com/redirect/e1b62a23-0eae-4d3f-a139-70f3be5336a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for stating on live television that African, Black, and Arab immigrant men pose the "main danger" to women in France. Anti-racism group Dilcrah sued her over her controversial comments.

* **D 'Escoeuffant says her views stem from personally surviving an alleged assault by a Tunisian migrant in 2022**, during which she says she was forcibly assaulted in her own apartment. Prosecutors argued she exploited the incident to fuel hate speech and build her social media profile, requesting a custodial sentence.
* **D 'Escoeuffant claims she's faced repeated violent attacks from Antifa activists,** numerous social media bans, and closed bank accounts. She remains defiant, arguing France suppresses anti-immigration speech while permitting "anti-white" rhetoric, and advocates for stricter border policies.

# **Trump Admin ends PEPFAR funding to South Africa over white farmer abandonment**
The Trump administration has notified South Africa it is terminating PEPFAR funding, citing the country's failure to address **[violence and discrimination against white South Africans.](https://substack.com/redirect/604b5d36-d9e8-4f38-90ed-c291a8722854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** The State Department outlined six unmet conditions, including condemning "kill the Boer" rhetoric, blocking land expropriation without compensation, and prioritizing rural crime reduction in high-risk farming areas.
* **A State Department spokesperson framed the decision around South Africa 's economic capacity,** noting the country is middle-income and able to fund its own health programs independently. The move follows months of escalating tension between Washington and Pretoria over the treatment of white farmers.
* **Trump has repeatedly raised the issue publicly,** including a tense May 2025 Oval Office meeting where he showed South African President Cyril Ramaphosa videos of political figures chanting about killing Boers and displayed articles documenting farmer killings, while also sparring with a reporter who tried redirecting the conversation toward an unrelated topic.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: The indignity of the moment that we’re living in.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
When I was first running for office, I did not have health insurance. I was a waitress and I was running against a 20-year incumbent.
It’s kind of crazy to ask people to support you against someone who has so much more experience than you, and to say: “Actually, one of the things that can make us more experienced is _actually having these experiences_.”
When I was running, I had to launch a canvass — but that morning a doctor told me I needed to take a blood test. I cried because I could not afford a blood test, especially without insurance.
So volunteers were walking around with clipboards with my face on it, asking people to vote for me for Congress, and I had to go to a student clinic and wait for four hours in the hope that somebody would see me.
Eight years later, I’m very privileged to be serving on the Energy and Commerce Committee in the House of Representatives. I worked to get on that committee because it has jurisdiction over all healthcare in the United States.
And every day that I sit in that committee, I am also that girl that was sitting in that clinic.
I know there are millions of us that are sitting in clinics and pharmacies every single day, having to make tough choices, and going home and not saying a word.
**That, at its core, is the indignity of the moment that we’re living in**.
Not just the sacrifices that we’re being asked to make, but the fact that we’re being asked to swallow it and not talk about it, as though it’s not happening to all of us.
They want to make it seem like it’s only happening to a small sliver of us.
But the truth is, **it’s killing all of us**.
We deserve so much better. And the brutal reality is, **we are all that we have**. To win a better world, we must stand together and fight for it.
Our main project now is to unite the working class in this country against a fascist agenda. Period.
[Will you make a $5 donation right now, ahead of my primary election on Tuesday, so I can keep fighting for progress in Congress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260618.G0mgyt&refcode=em20260618-11748-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=11748%2E2526796%2E0CcxJn)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3436%2E21716%2EVPmHSa)
Hi there,
This was a big week in Delaware politics! I just finished my 57 in 57 tour, visiting all of Delaware’s towns and cities in less than 3 days. And on Tuesday, **I officially filed the paperwork to run for re-election** and continue representing our neighbors in Congress.
**But I’m not the only one running — Delaware’s senior senator, and my friend, Chris Coons also launched his re-election campaign this week, and I’m proud to support him.**
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260618-1.9ozFDU&refcode=em20260618-3436&t=2&akid=3436%2E21716%2EVPmHSa)
Chris and I both know that small states can do big things. He’s spent his career fighting for our state and standing up for what’s right, and he knows that every Delawarean deserves access to a good-paying job and quality, affordable health care.
While I’m fighting for Delaware in the House, we need Chris’s voice and effective leadership in the Senate, which is why I’m thrilled to support his campaign.
And both Chris and I are going to need your help, too. We have a lot of work ahead of us, and it’s grassroots supporters like you who make our campaigns possible.

While you were filing your taxes this year, Donald Trump was making sure he'd never have to answer for his. A one-page document — signed by his attorney general, who used to be his personal lawyer — has shielded Trump, his children, and his businesses from IRS audits. "FOREVER BARRED and PRECLUDED" — that’s what the document actually says. Tax investigators estimate this deal could be worth more than $100 million to him personally. So I’m pushing back in the Senate. I've introduced the Presidential Tax Transparency Act to put a stop to this. It would require the President, Vice President, and candidates for those offices to publicly release 10 years of tax returns. No loopholes. No carveouts. No exceptions. [**The only way to counter concentrated power is with organized, visible, undeniable public pressure. That’s why I’m asking you to add your name if you agree that the law must apply equally to everyone, including the President of the United States.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumptax26/?source=EW_EMZ31W_IRS_ENG_20260618_F&t=8&akid=2936%2E4032634%2Ee7Yk-B) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumptax26/?source=EW_EMZ31W_IRS_ENG_20260618_F&t=9&akid=2936%2E4032634%2Ee7Yk-B)

If you skipped a tax bill, the IRS would come knocking. But Trump and his family? Protected — including from investigations stretching back more than a decade.
Tax experts and legal scholars have been clear: this is an extraordinary breakdown of the line between personal interest and public power. Teachers, nurses, firefighters — they all pay the IRS what they owe.
The tax code doesn't have a Trump family exemption. It shouldn't have one for anyone.
[**Accountability can't stop at the Oval Office. That's not how democracy works. It's how a system rigged for the wealthy and powerful works. Add your name today and help fight back.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trumptax26/?source=EW_EMZ31W_IRS_ENG_20260618_F&t=10&akid=2936%2E4032634%2Ee7Yk-B)

Elizabeth

I have very big news to share.
**We[ stopped](https://substack.com/redirect/cc219adb-f3cb-425c-a72f-4bc1a1eee95f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the two ICE detention centers!!!**
DHS is officially attempting to unload the warehouses in [Tremont and Hamburg](https://substack.com/redirect/a8a8eeff-b9e3-4333-8311-5f68033affc9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that they purchased to make into massive detention facilities.
Dan Meuser has egg on his face. He told us these would have a "[positive impact](https://substack.com/redirect/63459444-c346-4eba-9e1e-26986d1a85e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on our district. Even though these rural towns don't have the water or the infrastructure to handle massive facilities. They were going to need [150 poop trucks a day](https://substack.com/redirect/4591d374-9092-4d0a-b6d8-d419202a722c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to haul the sewage out.
Even DHS came to the conclusion that this was really, really stupid.
**We stopped this without our congressman 's help. With him actively working against us.**
Thank you to everyone who was a part of this. Thank you to everyone who showed up to our town halls, signed our petitions, and made your voice heard. This is a massive victory for our communities, and I'm so grateful to everyone who fought tooth and nail to make it happen.
Just a few months ago, the New York Times talked to a local business owner about these detention centers. He said, "We can have our little groups and we can sit and complain about it, but _how much power do we actually have to stop the federal government? "_
We have a lot. Today proves it.
That's what I'm carrying forward on this campaign. People say this race is going to be tough, but we just stopped what seemed inevitable. We won this fight, and we'll win the one in November.
**[Be a part of it. Chip in if you can to help me deliver representation that actually represents us.](https://substack.com/redirect/8def624b-9e27-42c3-aed1-c114f69d6479?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Thank you. Watch my video message on this here:

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. Peter,
We have the strongest stance on AI data centers in this race. We're the only campaign to call for a moratorium, and we're the strongest voice against the $2 billion in corporate tax breaks that Wisconsin is handing over to big tech.
More than a few folks have asked the obvious next question: If not server farms for big tech, then what? What would we build instead?

**CRANES & TRAINS** takes that $2 billion in tax breaks and puts every dollar toward Wisconsin workers building things Wisconsin actually needs:
* **Affordable housing:** $250 million through our public bank proposal, plus administrative support and a zoning overlay to speed up permitting for developers meeting strict affordability criteria.

* **Schools:** $500 million for urgent renovations, plus a statewide survey of school building conditions.
* **Transit:** $50 million for Madison–Milwaukee high-speed rail (projected to create 200 permanent union jobs) plus $200 million for bike/bus infrastructure, sidewalks, and EV charging.

**While Donald Trump and the entire MAGA movement continue running wild, Democrats are standing up, speaking out, and fighting back** – in DC, on the campaign trail, and in communities like yours across the country.
In the House, Democratic Leader **Hakeem Jeffries** is waging an all-out war against Republican attempts to rig the 2026 elections through gerrymandering and voter suppression. And **Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez** is calling out Trump's unauthorized war against Iran for what it is – an unconstitutional power grab with no congressional approval and no clear plan.
In Georgia, Senator **Jon Ossoff** – the only Senate Democrat running for re-election in a state Trump won – is going straight at the president, calling him “spiritually broken” and morally unfit for the office he holds.

# Forward, Northerners!
---
| | | _To our Friends and Supporters,_ The summer is heating up and so is the 7th CD Campaign. I’m home this week from the Wisconsin Democratic Convention. Party conventions were always something I tried to avoid when I could. The long platform debates and the endless speeches! But conventions are a necessary part of our political system. And they are a great way to connect with lots of old friends, and to make new ones.
---
| | |
---
| | | You could think of this year’s convention theme as building a big enough surfboard to ride the blue wave that's coming our way. Check out my convention speech [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133600173/628419204/1981241912?feature=share&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGFiY2YyMjktNmI2Yi1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTg5MDVjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=h8mPbf4GY-amr39Kjhojwajj1MXJfN_jF1a-YxxRIzw=&emci=318c98d6-3b6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=8abcf229-6b6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=28718937). It’s clear that our Clark for Wisconsin campaign has a strong base of support from folks from within the 7th CD, and those following this race statewide. And it’s also clear that, for the first time in years, that politicos and journalists from all over Wisconsin are now eyeing the 7th CD race as newly competitive and one to watch!Our opportunity is being handed to us every week and it’s up to us to capture it with a strong campaign. Now it's all up to us back here in the north country to turn out our neighbors, no matter what their past political affiliation, to vote. **Our Iran Debacle** You’ve probably heard about the preliminary cease fire agreement between the US and Iran. It’s simply astonishing and it looks an awful lot like a flat out surrender.This is what happens when you fire the career diplomats - and send your son in law and your buddy to cut deals with terrorists.You can see a video with my statement [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133600174/628419205/-65851827?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGFiY2YyMjktNmI2Yi1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTg5MDVjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=h8mPbf4GY-amr39Kjhojwajj1MXJfN_jF1a-YxxRIzw=&emci=318c98d6-3b6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=8abcf229-6b6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=28718937). They took America’s strong opening hand and shoved one of the world’s biggest piles of chips into the middle. And in four months they’ve proceeded to just about lose it all on what has to stand as one of the world’s worst suckers bets. They’ve given away every point of leverage we held. All sanctions lifted and Iranian assets unfrozen - all for no binding agreements, even around nuclear materials. And the Straits of Hormuz reopening - apparently as an Iranian controlled tollway that we'll be paying the tolls for. But for all this war has cost us, including the lives of our service members, and the lives of innocent Iranian civilians, and in higher costs for gasoline, food, fertilizer and other things we need to live, they just stuck the fine men and women of our military in a war they couldn't win and teed up a spectacular strategic defeat. If you’re wondering why Congress was never consulted on going to war, and never consulted on the terms of this surrender, you’re asking the right questions. America’s still not out of cards, but we have got to put those cards in the hands of serious people smart enough and disciplined enough to win. The only way to hold the people responsible for this mess accountable is to vote like you mean it in November.**Summer is Here and We’d Love for you to Join Us!** Kelby, Connor, Anney and the rest of our team have been working on a growing list of summer events and related volunteer opportunities. This is the season for visibility! Please see the details for a listing of parades, festivals, and upcoming events. And please sign up to volunteer for parades or other events - we’d love to have you join us. We’ll see you out on the trail!

# _On the Road_
---
| | | **With Mary Mack in Eau Claire** Let's be candid, political folks usually stink at comedy - we're so wired to being serious all the time! Last month fellow 7th CD gal and comedienne Mary Mack invited a few of us candidates to join one of her Comedy Hour shows in Eau Claire. A great chance to lighten up and stop taking life so seriously.
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | **At the PCA Plant in Tomahawk** On his way down to Madison for the convention, Fred had the opportunity to stop by the Packaging Corporation of America plant in Tomahawk. This containerboard mill employs hundreds of people from the area, and specializes in thick, corrugated cardboard used for boxes and other packaging products. We need to do all that we can to keep plants like this one open for generations, and create a new set of policies at the federal level to encourage investment in communities like Tomahawk. For too long, federal trade and regulatory policies have encouraged companies to send their capital and labor demands overseas, mortgaging our future for the elusive promise of lower prices. Winning in the 21st century will require a modernized, growing, and innovative manufacturing sector.Achieving this will also, in addition to preserving our country’s economic stature, give towns like Tomahawk the opportunity and financial security to stay afloat.
---
| | | **Ballot Challenges All Around** As reported by Rich Kremer of Wisconsin Public Radio and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, the Wisconsin Elections Commission rejected the legal challenges brought by 7th CD Republican candidate Jessi Ebben's campaign and her high priced attorneys over minor wording on nomination signature forms of our campaign and the campaigns of two of Jessi’s fellow Republican candidates. If upheld, her challenges would have forced the removal of Michael Alfonso and Kevin Hermaning from the August 11th Primary election ballot. But it sure looks like the knives are out between my fellow Republican candidates for the 7th Congressional District! And we've got two full months to go. The Wisconsin Election Commissioners who rejected this frivolous challenge without debate on a unanimous vote showed a lot of common sense. Primary voters on August 11th will get to choose who appears on the November ballot - and that's the way it should be.
