Fellow Conservative,

Imagine, for a moment, switching shoes with an active-duty Navy SEAL.

**The satellite phone rang at 3:00 a.m. local time.**

You’re in a 20-foot shipping container turned command post, somewhere in the Horn of Africa you never see on a map.

_**No staff. No teleprompter. No second chances.**_

One of our teams was pinned down.

Bad guys closing in.

Decision time: **_**extract now and risk the helo, or hold and risk the men.**_**

[**SUPPORT A NAVY SEAL
**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=02b66ea45aaf453e9af88c0c784d0878&_e=uzeovoRYQkEvpsBGrvEGYal5uQCYxerJ58dGgunnjNgWEBnJaJGZrC89y8DRhngAqxRS0Mf7yzBOhqyWenMtnAfowgC6ULtAZ-OWHL3aw3vmFiEqu07HZQayDG2p3HH2VgMcK3v0GpfvtdCnddI5rzpNNf4889IN5oTFTAMlIMjcMy2TE-dv9vfndtDx6yBm9p_QVCTlmEWk3-H12VIkgOqewQfcxQ4wHnq8dNEY7j0RpRiBDVfN_5tDz_bwQp-scI6ZOrYl2XPzVL7D0jMrEFBQDMa2Kv6aOEkWFkfNQE3hmdYRV-_m7Jk1AEbacUK71GheE0mgnAbN3JwkQSqv9Q2pgVFKpvwYYmWmBm9q3VdyPzzWZ622ZbFC3UB8PDmzkxGfcjhiPWW09G070e1_2niVgMB_8DKVz77HH6c5joldjIPDp2repZWWLtwrkfS7-vNYZw5LHM8d1TIkYeywKlDdcBm18ygMw2oEKhGNgWUA1Wl4EELkixzFQb0GIWlrk1YgJ663DzhuwUkFL0lmNg0v5fGIa3PUCFbJmdVSl31H5Wld1wTPrCqoOrr4ax0v8UOfyIzInEnd4qPblfKraIs7hwwOHrNY9G9A4otnuzktgbcUX_Q7cYzb_shYA7Lq-3ZA5FdAUXqiJqGh0LELVppbGK2EtcYNLQuIKBnBtqm6SuSKd90S0bRKgJlbecPc2BFkRLZkT3XxveZ1ougTTg%3D%3D)
You make the call. You get every American home.

_**That’s what a real 3 A.M. decision feels like.**_

Now, Minnesota faces its own 3 A.M. moments—only the phone is ringing in **Minneapolis, St. Cloud, Duluth.**
1. A 74% spike in carjackings since 2020.

2. Illegals with criminal records released into our neighborhoods because Walz-Flanagan sued to defund ICE detention.

3. Small-town hospitals are closing because state mandates crushed rural budgets.

But this isn’t just happening in Minnesota - it’s happening all across the country. In big cities, small towns, and in state capitals, with out-of-touch career politicians leading the charge.

That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate - because Americans need a battle-tested former Navy SEAL, like me, ready to take the tough 3:00 a.m. calls that are commonplace at the highest levels of government.

_**My opponent?**_

**_She’s never taken a 3 A.M. call that didn’t come with a donor list attached._**

**I’m Adam Schwarze—former Navy SEAL Officer, Marine Corps veteran, lifelong Minnesotan.**

I’ve done ****nine combat deployments**** across ****70 countries****. I’ve led men when the margin between life and death was measured in seconds.

**_Minnesota doesn’t need another career politician who reads a poll at 3:00 A.M._**

We need a Senator who has ****already answered the 3 A.M. call**** —and brought everyone home.

I recently won the endorsement of the Minnesota Republican Party - a critical step in our quest to flip this seat in November. **[Now, I’m asking you to step up if we’re to have any chance of flipping this seat for the first time since 2008.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=02b66ea45aaf453e9af88c0c784d0878&_e=uzeovoRYQkEvpsBGrvEGYal5uQCYxerJ58dGgunnjNgWEBnJaJGZrC89y8DRhngAqxRS0Mf7yzBOhqyWenMtnAfowgC6ULtAZ-OWHL3aw3vmFiEqu07HZQayDG2p3HH2VgMcK3v0GpfvtdCnddI5rzpNNf4889IN5oTFTAMlIMjcMy2TE-dv9vfndtDx6yBm9p_QVCTlmEWk3-H12VIkgOqewQfcxQ4wHnq8dNEY7j0RpRiBDVfN_5tDz_bwQp-s75y-kaT9Y3VMCLck4T8unEdNJRFB_AjJhWJL0N6FWniuWeXcxa9MZ3hfPUKVrGOl-fPQQs0aHZrQ2NWFb_sgicN0Uy2BIrlIKhR7SzF50j4heCGU09rUqSUWc3GE1boZnbTdmh_XB9w6n54cBFY2m0i_sGsrJPy6T7efy9M0uqpWc3hSUS0-Dpa-hLi3GJnBIiXCmr4I11JPzwhLMZ9lcGzmyfQmHXw7q5M9MGgZIYxvXn6cW3ppN2k06i6BTbfMXipf5lE-RkOgrAaneujQnH9LngUkhorGju5JDzLHsXRvadBtjAzIfRfkPRNQl_Npzwdmb2V8-Ey2-4YlSJcDBY18Q_Pd-aHKZWmHOIlNi_VDH6Rsa5iiS08zdmsQzIRQccJVjM8hMq3hy5AJNORw-sn-fybjZjnqKtmsd4ZKmtnkCkiWq_URzKj-_b6ZVLtB3m1M2Gp1FEsJ-VVjI862Fw%3D%3D)**

clean_body: The Washington elites just got a loud wake-up call from Minnesota. | Fellow Conservative, Imagine, for a moment, switching shoes with an active-duty Navy SEAL. The satellite phone rang at 3:00 a.m. local time. You’re in a 20-foot shipping container turned command post, somewhere in the Horn of Africa you never see on a map. No staff. No teleprompter. No second chances. One of our teams was pinned down. Bad guys closing in. Decision time: extract now and risk the helo, or hold and risk the men. You make the call. You get every American home. That’s what a real 3 A.M. decision feels like. Now, Minnesota faces its own 3 A.M. moments—only the phone is ringing in Minneapolis, St. Cloud, Duluth. 1. A 74% spike in carjackings since 2020. 2. Illegals with criminal records released into our neighborhoods because Walz-Flanagan sued to defund ICE detention. 3. Small-town hospitals are closing because state mandates crushed rural budgets. But this isn’t just happening in Minnesota - it’s happening all across the country. In big cities, small towns, and in state capitals, with out-of-touch career politicians leading the charge. That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate - because Americans need a battle-tested former Navy SEAL, like me, ready to take the tough 3:00 a.m. calls that are commonplace at the highest levels of government. My opponent? She’s never taken a 3 A.M. call that didn’t come with a donor list attached. I’m Adam Schwarze—former Navy SEAL Officer, Marine Corps veteran, lifelong Minnesotan. I’ve done **nine combat deployments across 70 countries. I’ve led men when the margin between life and death was measured in seconds. Minnesota doesn’t need another career politician who reads a poll at 3:00 A.M. We need a Senator who has already answered the 3 A.M. call —and brought everyone home. I recently won the endorsement of the Minnesota Republican Party - a critical step in our quest to flip this seat in November. Could you please I have a story to tell and a lot of fight in me, but the one thing we don’t have is money. I’m not backed by Hollywood or D.C. consultants. I’m backed by you. For love of country, Adam Schwarze Minnesota Republican Party Endorsed Candidate for U.S. Senate Former Navy SEAL officer Marine Corps Veteran Proud Minnesotan FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA** | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. name: Andrew Sneed
subject: Peter, June 16th was just the beginning.
body:
We can't slow down - and I need your help.
---
| | | | [ View in browser](https://h8g0t.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/mr/sh/SMJz09SDriOHTaoDGkpqIpMfjg9x/i0w-WBgHR0xt)
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
#### Peter,

On June 16th, the people of the Fifth District sent a message: we are ready for **__real change__**.
On Tuesday, with your help, I won the Democratic runoff with almost 80% of the votes cast. Thank you for trusting me to fight for the voice of the people of this district and unseat Dale Strong in November.
We deserve a representative that listens and shows up for this district - every member of this district - and I intend to be that Representative.
---
| [ Let's Do This!](https://h8g0t.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBlbNaKGvxQIyuMhJZ/MxiT-4w_Wi0B)
---
[ ](https://h8g0t.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13DkCXVR5RW8HeKztp/Hvfph4E6sxN3)
Here's something I want you to know: over the last six weeks, our team made a deliberate choice. We focused every ounce of our energy on getting out the vote, not on fundraising. You heard from us about polling places, absentee ballots, and phonebanking shifts. What you didn't hear was a constant drumbeat asking for money.
I stand by that choice. Votes come first. Always.
But now it's time to jump in with both feet and donate to reach our goal of $200,000 by the end of the quarter: June 30th.
| [ I'm With Andrew!](https://h8g0t.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uft1UgbEvbxaOJIU5/mzcX5AuNjWRL)
---
I'll be honest with you, we're at a disadvantage. Dale Strong currently has $1.3 million cash-on-hand. In order to defeat him in November, we need to be able to reach every voter in the district, and that takes donations.
Every dollar comes from people like you. Not special interests, not corporate PACs - just neighbors, friends, and believers.
If you believe North Alabama deserves a congressman who actually works for this community, I hope you'll contribute to this campaign.

Any amount makes a difference. $5. $25. $100. This is a people-powered campaign, and that is exactly how we win.
| [ I'm Chipping in Today!](https://h8g0t.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm81qRrlOPhmt8Hb4L/mngnF6wJPONf)
---
We can't take our foot off the gas. Thank you for standing with me. Let's win this in November, together.
With gratitude,Andrew

| | | |
---
**Andrew Sneed for Congress**
614 Madison Street, 35801, Huntsville

| | | Friend,My name is Eduardo Verastegui.I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation.** Years ago, after hearing firsthand stories about children trapped in trafficking, my life changed forever.What I learned broke my heart.Children were being bought and sold. Exploited. Abused. Forgotten.And most people had no idea this evil was happening all around us.That is why I made the film Sound of Freedom.**Not for Hollywood.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.**
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=bbb818c52a5c467e9c40821b13449669&_e=K619X0qFOqfsS8S21ZDldyJlcBo_x9hUuwa904CDyMNtW8vyWW6M92Uv5dTqQMXMRu8RrFkZ-I3UhSbFLvOtk_bMBuw9W0dVqgek6g1cgtjNcTB87BcFY5d_Tk3foqghN4k-zwO2S9PWsAJRgPzpq37Rgjzgg-PZNREDdHLJHUjGumbvw7chejySE8ZhDISisQgpphoG2iLWgLoXPMDfdSA9u4TGQCuR1C48_6DnXqjrMgNGvHJbZZPwxN2LTPhO1EpRc83ZhfLR-bVstATVpdj4gl7bXdQ6ptgI06j7qRtfBeEUoj7wOIXy9Z4OSzWuIWvgUHUJL9iXDunse37QYqoXZayTVtVc1K3t-GL7BC_aKAHPJ0m-2cfMIGPPbP88MFFMOX6ZDTvgw4KgTnq13z62JjwEGsW2rJvu88nSyBtXMyBjrZKJlbapKAjX5IWOfgFZZ_AGsiMAevRzzNLuISEmTgR7Axbx2NUr1xyxFCaNagoOtszMxND62wHKlzYXHlWhuqYoMNAlehE8D4XVpw0LEAthbw-LrcIdYewP8zNYmSvCGgxrWr5SqoUkhDgLhIRcSQySSDhlkKsRaYd5OYY3zrdquhtdRYXPNNEWp-5My47u13c0l190lUfISamY4B0YHchCho4oR_4qIJ70mkawynwYqK0dUKn1uf5AvSRqZQh3PTUsPG4yIM0NXyb1)
---
Today, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** continues that mission beyond the movie screen.
---
[ Help Stop Child Trafficking](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=bbb818c52a5c467e9c40821b13449669&_e=K619X0qFOqfsS8S21ZDldyJlcBo_x9hUuwa904CDyMNtW8vyWW6M92Uv5dTqQMXMRu8RrFkZ-I3UhSbFLvOtk_bMBuw9W0dVqgek6g1cgtjNcTB87BcFY5d_Tk3foqghN4k-zwO2S9PWsAJRgPzpq37Rgjzgg-PZNREDdHLJHUjGumbvw7chejySE8ZhDISisQgpphoG2iLWgLoXPMDfdSA9u4TGQCuR1C48_6DnXqgyH5AUhFdABW6rmNkrQvqCkbW_SszOGFWd6UI6MLuqp3VwpHLbQFKLAKToT8S2hp8etey4WdPiLOlnIjl9LiBzAOnlSLh8sCSJIoIgc7Aq60cu1f-r6fAOdRxGFDg0B78sLvFY0kwD7LemPpt23x_C47F9veShk2l7FIOH4Dx_zycbLh8OJuFBTgrOfNfhNWjovXC2eCzXpuVvDJE-8Sp2D1EbZ7y89gc0G7TR0oNdZCCJCxf5M47nvLqkrM_oS-4gJZjP2YdNE5g4IARxpuN4sknNX1KuzLTSbKb-mwe1Lj9PpSfWSpWUt0mEutbNa8-Jb0845oi-kSrsw63Gjgdx7oXp7M0AozAlkSb43f61dbQ56f8X1C_V2etb3TP9LyRCw0Zq6t1hYZlWAjnO6gh_GXmcylGIr7cS4DK7MmBE1rCEIUFWhkGCGE3kcwKyCz1RwwA6t2iqMgI20oHFz4Wn)

**We exist to stop the sale of God 's children.**And right now, we are urgently preparing for a major threat connected to the premier international soccer tournament coming up in June and July.Millions of visitors will flood into 16 cities across the United States, Mexico, and Canada. New Jersey alone will host eight matches including the final game.Nearby Philadelphia will host six more.While families gather to celebrate soccer, traffickers often use large international events like this to exploit vulnerable people, especially children.
---
[ Help Stop Child Trafficking](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=bbb818c52a5c467e9c40821b13449669&_e=K619X0qFOqfsS8S21ZDldyJlcBo_x9hUuwa904CDyMNtW8vyWW6M92Uv5dTqQMXMRu8RrFkZ-I3UhSbFLvOtk_bMBuw9W0dVqgek6g1cgtjNcTB87BcFY5d_Tk3foqghN4k-zwO2S9PWsAJRgPzpq37Rgjzgg-PZNREDdHLJHUjGumbvw7chejySE8ZhDISisQgpphoG2iLWgLoXPMDfdSA9u4TGQCuR1C48_6DnXqiKDCGplpZu862m853Y7wyeoNnUqUto40DdYgeEYGPL-IIA270EcLtoaK_8gAq8jqs22M7r26VJ5guGwi8_ZCF4wVQLqKTT4VvoOnOV2QTtHIgj0lFDywvIDKF27TK_kt0B37SUJNH4rmo3PLUl0clh3ZF5D3o_Wqnegm8NRvz__0PpkLFrydmOi-nCFeJ1LHgXjqSBObmyXpPwVEMpmZ1EerMKd8BTzEcy2ZE_oj2Gf60fXjn4YubMv0bTvZ4b5QPej290hyUUDq7CRhVmdBecEME-VXSh5Bkk5sKZcQHjxCs0EaL3vheGXjbAU6XobV7PtNtVaDYC0_F0BRUIdbsa-7qjZlAH5OBAwDbkm8ZBQtQcfXh0IXRa55f0jG6m7J6l1WPTuXW6xTKYxLgj_Ue_YzfNIfwz7lussmoll4UhAumFWimRza2EDd2qjWVX3neJAFbXB09p7IBFV7h6TSMV)

That's why survivor-informed community groups and anti-trafficking leaders are mobilizing before the games begin.Volunteers and community partners across New Jersey will gather with **Sound of Freedom Foundation** partners to take action against traffickers.This collaborative effort will provide:
---
* trainings and presentations
* outreach opportunities
* community toolkits designed to help prevent trafficking before, during, and after the tournament

---
Survivors of trafficking themselves will help lead these trainings.They will prepare volunteers to reach hotels and motels near tournament activity zones with prevention resources and awareness materials.**Because awareness saves lives.**
**Education protects children.
**
**Staying silent helps traffickers.**

Talarico said, "I don't think Ken Paxton or Ted Cruz are in a position to tell anybody what a real man is." That tells you everything you need to know about James Talarico. This is the same James Talarico who said God is nonbinary. Talarico is right about one thing. Actions speak louder than words.Ken's record speaks for itself. So does Talarico's. But here is the urgent reality. Talarico has raised over $40 million. He has a 3-point lead in a recent poll. Cook Political Report has already downgraded this race. And he is spending his time on MSNBC instead of in Texas because he thinks this race is already over.
